This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals. Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.

Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology's development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry. This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon's cost targets.

Key job responsibilities

The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.

- Lead Product Development Process working cross-functional supply chain team dedicated to the supplier, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics decisions, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment.
- Act as single point of contact for program resources (leadership and working teams) to communicate Supply Chain decisions and progress, provide feedback on supply chain implications of program decisions and changes, and support financial planning and capital approvals for the program.
- Work with Robotics leadership to ensure partnership between Robotics Supply Chain, hardware engineering, operations and program teams on commodity and supplier selection, cost performance tradeoff analysis, cost road map development and execution, and enabling rapid product development stages, and delivering an effective path to scaled deployment.
- Responsible for definition and approval of the Product level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmap to meet payback targets, definition of capacity plan and associated sourcing and tooling requirements, supply chain risk assessment & mitigation plans.
- Work with sourcing in developing negotiation strategies for categories which impacts the product to deliver against business objectives and achieve sustainable relationships with strategic suppliers pertaining to Amazon Robotics products supporting the priority programs as driven by the Operating Plan (OP)
- Work with GCMs on managing overall supplier relationships including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Develop roadmap to achieving total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities
- Ensure non-cost goals (Sustainability, Supplier Development, Cost Savings) are met and supported by the product specific supply chain strategy.

title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Senior Legal Counsel (m/f/d)

description:
SENIOR LEGAL COUNSEL M/M/F


About the role

We are delighted to represent a leading asset manager within a global financial group, committed to delivering long-term value through responsible investment solutions and sustainable practices.

Based in Luxembourg, you will join an international and multicultural Fund Law team, working alongside experienced legal professionals across multiple locations. As a trusted legal partner to the business, you will provide pragmatic legal solutions that enable business opportunities while ensuring compliance with Luxembourg and European regulatory requirements.

This role has a primary focus on the legal aspects of a UCITS Management Company and AIFM, including governance, outsourcing arrangements, regulatory compliance and corporate legal matters. You will also support investment fund-related activities, including fund documentation and product development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead, coordinate and support legal and regulatory projects and strategic initiatives, with a primary focus on Management Company and AIFM legal matters.
• Advise the business on governance, corporate legal matters, outsourcing frameworks and other Management Company-related regulatory requirements.
• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of legal documentation, including outsourcing agreements, service agreements, prospectuses, board resolutions and other corporate legal documents.
• Provide practical legal advice on Luxembourg and European regulatory requirements applicable to Management Companies, AIFMs and investment funds.
• Coordinate and manage regulatory filings and interactions with the CSSF and other competent authorities where required.
• Partner closely with Governance, Compliance, Risk, Product Development and other business functions, as well as external legal advisers.
• Support investment fund-related matters, including fund documentation, product launches, cross-border distribution and ongoing legal maintenance.
• Drive continuous improvements to legal processes, governance frameworks and documentation standards.
• Build trusted relationships with stakeholders by providing proactive legal guidance and helping identify legal and regulatory implications of business initiatives.

Profile sought

• Master's degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification.
• 10+ years of post-qualification experience within the asset management industry, a leading law firm or a consulting environment.
• Strong experience within the Luxembourg investment funds industry, including extensive exposure to Management Company and/or AIFM legal matters.
• In-depth knowledge of the Luxembourg legal and regulatory framework applicable to UCITS Management Companies, AIFMs and investment funds.
• Demonstrated experience advising on governance, outsourcing arrangements and regulatory requirements applicable to Luxembourg Management Companies.
• Proven track record of interacting with the CSSF on Management Company and fund-related matters.
• Strong commercial judgement with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical business solutions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across international and cross-functional teams.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable working in a dynamic environment with evolving regulatory requirements.
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative international team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French and/or German would be considered a strong advantage.

Application process:

As an equal opportunity employer, we embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Please note, however, that candidates must possess a valid Luxembourg work permit. As we represent our clients, we are required to submit only those who meet this requirement. Unfortunately, if you do not have a valid work permit, we will not be able to consider your application.

If you are selected for the position, you will be asked to provide supporting documentation, such as copies of your diplomas, proof of prior employment, and a standard criminal record check, as part of the final steps in our recruitment process.

We appreciate your interest in our company and look forward to the possibility of working together.

Fixed term contract | Belval | 18 Months
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be mainly in charge of:
• Designing and evaluating inter-satellite link (ISL) architectures tailored to GEO proximity operations, covering both RF and optical crosslink technologies.
• Developing cooperative communication protocols enabling real-time coordination, sensing cueing, and state exchanges between heterogeneous satellite payloads.
• Defining interface specifications to ensure seamless integration of the networking layer with onboard optical and RF sensing systems.
• Designing predictive and resilient networking strategies leveraging orbital geometry and interference-aware link adaptation.
• Contributing to system-level integration and ground-based demonstration activities validating the communication architecture.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• PhD in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field

Experience and skills
• Research experience in the areas of satellite communications, inter-satellite links, or non-terrestrial networks (NTN)
• Strong background in communication protocol design, including cross-layer optimization, QoS management, and time-critical networking
• Familiarity with 5G/6G architectural concepts and their applicability to space systems (deterministic latency, distributed scheduling, AI-driven link management)
• Experience with simulation and modelling tools for satellite communication systems
• Knowledge of RF and/or optical link technologies is an asset
• Experience in multi-partner research projects is an asset
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary, international team

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits
• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A scientific CV with contact details
• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
• Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.

Description & Requirements

BGL BNP Paribas est une des plus grandes banques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et fait partie du Groupe BNP Paribas.

Elle propose à ses clients particuliers, professionnels, entreprises et de banque privée une gamme particulièrement large de produits financiers et de solutions de bancassurance.

En 2024, BGL BNP Paribas a été désignée « Best Bank in Luxembourg » par Euromoney et a obtenu en 2025, pour la 10è année consécutive, la certification « Top Employer Luxembourg », saluant l'excellence des conditions de travail offertes à ses collaborateurs.

Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons, pour une embauche en CDI, un/une :

Customer Interactions Officer H/F

CONTEXTE ET ENJEUX

Chez BGL BNP Paribas, nous plaçons l'expérience client au cœur de notre stratégie. Dans un environnement en pleine transformation, nous faisons évoluer notre marketing vers davantage de personnalisation, d'exploitation de la donnée, d'automatisation et d'innovation afin d'offrir à nos clients des interactions toujours plus pertinentes.
En rejoignant le Centre d'Expertise Marketing & Communication, vous contribuerez directement à renforcer l'engagement de nos clients et à construire le marketing bancaire de demain.
  
CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ?

Au sein de l'équipe Customer Engagement, vous concevez, pilotez et optimisez les campagnes de marketing relationnel destinées à nos différentes clientèles.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Analyser les données et comportements clients afin d'identifier les meilleures opportunités d'engagement.
• Concevoir et coordonner des campagnes multicanales ciblées.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Produits, Digital, Data, Juridique, Compliance et Commerciales pour garantir la qualité des campagnes.
• Créer des contenus adaptés à chaque cible dans le respect de notre identité de marque.
• Suivre la performance des campagnes, analyser les résultats et recommander des optimisations.
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques marketing, de nos outils et de nos parcours clients.
• Expérimenter progressivement les apports de l'intelligence artificielle afin d'accélérer la création de contenus, l'analyse de données et la performance de nos campagnes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'expérimentation, l'analyse de la performance et l'amélioration continue font partie intégrante de notre manière de travailler

LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !

Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et collaborative au sein du Centre d'Expertise Marketing & Communication.
Vous travaillerez quotidiennement avec des experts du marketing, de la data, du digital, des parcours clients et des métiers commerciaux afin de concevoir des expériences clients à forte valeur ajoutée.

Ce poste vous permettra de :

• contribuer à des projets stratégiques ayant un impact concret sur l'expérience client ;
• développer vos compétences en CRM, marketing relationnel, data marketing et intelligence artificielle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage la collaboration, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue ;
• bénéficier d'une grande diversité de sujets et d'interlocuteurs.

ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR COLLABORATEUR ?

• Vous êtes apte à comprendre les attentes des clients et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Vous êtes curieux(se), orienté(e) résultats et appréciez autant l'analyse que la créativité.
• Vous aimez travailler en équipe, coordonner plusieurs parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets.
• Vous avez envie de contribuer à la transformation du marketing et d'améliorer en permanence l'expérience de nos clients en challengeant le status quo et en pilotant des initiatives de change

Vous disposez également :
• d'un Master en Marketing, Communication ou domaine équivalent ;
• d'une expérience justifiée en CRM, marketing relationnel ou gestion de campagnes ;
• d'une maîtrise des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel et PowerPoint ;
• d'une connaissance approfondie des outils marketing, de l'A/B test, de l'automatisation marketing et l'intelligence artificielle générative.

La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est indispensable. L'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.
  
TRAVAILLER CHEZ BNP PARIBAS C'EST :

• Prendre part au grand projet de transformation de notre Groupe vers la construction d'un monde plus durable.
Découvrez nos engagements : Nos engagements pour nos clients et la société | BNP Paribas
• Bénéficier d'une offre de formation riche pour développer continuellement ses compétences et se préparer aux métiers de demain, dans un monde en constante évolution
• Elargir ses perspectives et exercer différents métiers au cours de sa carrière grâce à la variété de nos activités et notre gestion dynamique des carrières
• Préserver son équilibre de vie grâce à notre système d'horaire mobile, à nos deux sites satellites aux frontières belge et française et au télétravail
• Evoluer au quotidien dans un environnement où il fait bon vivre et travailler. A l'écoute de la voix de nos employés, nous avons à cœur d'offrir un cadre de travail de qualité, fondé sur le respect, la diversité, l'inclusion et la convivialité.

Dans un monde qui change, la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont des valeurs clés pour le bien-être et la performance des équipes. Chez BNP Paribas, nous souhaitons accueillir et fidéliser tous les talents sans distinction : c'est ainsi que nous construirons, ensemble, la finance de demain, innovante, responsable et durable.

Dans le cadre de la finalisation du processus de recrutement, il sera demandé au candidat présélectionné un extrait de casier judiciaire datant de moins de 3 mois (bulletin n°3 pour le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg), conformément aux dispositions de la loi du 23 juillet 2016 relative au casier judiciaire, compte tenu du domaine d'activité de notre établissement.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist (m/f)
description:
Description:

Founded in 1979 through a partnership between Electrolux and the World Health Organization (WHO), B Medical Systems has grown into a global leader in vaccine cold chain solutions and a trusted provider of temperature-controlled solutions for the healthcare, global humanitarian procurement, pharmaceutical, life sciences, and blood transfusion sectors. For over four decades, we have designed and manufactured innovative medical refrigeration and vaccine cold chain solutions that protect vaccines, blood, biological samples, and other temperature-sensitive products in more than 170 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Luxembourg, B Medical Systems combines innovation, engineering excellence, and advanced manufacturing capabilities to deliver solutions that meet the highest international standards.

To support our continued growth, we are recruiting a dynamic, business-minded, and performance-driven professional for the position of:

Digital Marketing Specialist (m / f / d)

The Digital Marketing Specialist will be responsible for driving B Medical Systems' digital growth by increasing the visibility and discoverability of the company, its brand portfolio and products, and converting digital engagement into qualified leads. The role will own and continuously develop the company's digital marketing ecosystem across traditional and AI-powered search, website, paid media, social media campaigns and other relevant digital channels.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own and execute the digital growth and lead-generation strategy, with clear accountability for generating qualified inbound leads.
• Develop integrated digital campaigns across Google Ads/PPC, LinkedIn and other paid social, display and relevant emerging channels across relevant market segments, products, and customer groups to increase awareness, traffic, engagement and conversion.
• Own and continuously improve B Medical Systems' visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search and discovery platforms, including Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc.
• Develop and execute SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and related strategies to increase brand and product discoverability and generate relevant traffic and leads.
• Manage key elements of technical and on-page SEO, including search intent, metadata, internal linking, crawlability and indexation, structured data/schema, site architecture, backlinks and website performance.
• Act as a key business owner of the B Medical Systems website from a visibility, user journey, lead-generation and conversion perspective.
• Create, update and optimise webpages, product pages, landing pages and campaign pages using CMS platforms such as WordPress.
• Continuously improve website traffic quality, conversion rates, calls-to-action, lead-capture mechanisms and overall digital customer journeys.
• Evaluate and leverage new advertising opportunities, including AI-powered platforms, as they become relevant.
• Review French and/or German translations of marketing materials.
• Support e-commerce, catalogues, marketplaces and other online product-placement platforms where relevant.
• Define and monitor KPIs covering digital leads, pipeline contribution, traffic, AI/search visibility, conversion rates, campaign performance, CPL/CPA and other relevant commercial metrics.

Education:  Bachelor's degree in marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience in digital, growth or performance marketing, preferably within a B2B environment.
Technical Knowledge:
• Strong knowledge of SEO and modern search optimisation, including AEO, GEO and AI-driven discovery.
• Proven experience generating leads through digital marketing and managing paid acquisition campaigns, including Google Ads/PPC and LinkedIn.
• Hands-on experience in creating, managing and optimising websites and landing pages through CMS platforms such as WordPress.
• E-commerce/digital product platform experience would be an advantage.
• Working proficiency in English and, French or German is mandatory.

Skills:

• Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept through execution and optimisation.
• Hands-on and proactive, with the ability to develop strategy while personally executing campaigns, website improvements and experiments.
• Collaborative and organised, with the ability to work effectively across teams while managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines.
• High attention to detail, commitment to quality and a positive, collaborative working approach.

Miscellaneous:  Preference will be given to a candidate who can join immediately or within a short period of time.

If you are interested in gaining experience in a growing Luxembourg-based company and are analytical and detail-oriented, we would like to meet you.
What we offer you? A fast-growing company, an international environment, exciting challenges, a dynamic workplace
… And more reasons to join us … If you are interested in this position and meet
the job requirements, please apply via our web site:  https://www.bmedicalsystems.com/en/about-us/career/

title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
description:
Description:

Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech
Job ID: 10522151 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promise, across hundreds of millions of packages daily? SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the science behind these decisions. We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Luxembourg (alternatively: Barcelona, or London). You will design and build optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at scale from real-time order assignment and multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to capacity-aware control systems that steer millions of shipments per hour toward operational plans.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization models (MIP, heuristics, decomposition) that solve large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

• PhD
• Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Unix/Linux
• Experience in professional software development

title: Business Relationship Advisor - Agrifood (m/f/x)
description:
About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
The National Business Relationship Department works directly with Luxembourg-based companies — from SMEs to large enterprises — to identify their innovation needs, connect them to the right support services and accelerate their growth. The department acts as the primary interface between the business ecosystem and Luxinnovation's programmes, funding instruments and expert networks.
Job description
As an Agrifood Innovation & Business Relationship Advisor, you will serve as the main point of contact for agrifood companies in Luxembourg, identifying their needs and contributing to the digitalisation and decarbonisation of the sector. You will work closely with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture and relevant sector-specific associations to support SMEs and large companies in their innovation journey toward sustainable agriculture and food innovation.
You will map the agrifood ecosystem, build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and ensure that companies benefit from tailored Luxinnovation services, R&D collaborations and national or European funding opportunities.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire:
• Organise and lead collaborative workgroups on decarbonisation, digitalisation and sustainable agriculture for agrifood SMEs
• Provide expert insights on agrifood innovation trends and contribute to the organisation of sector-specific events and conferences
• Stay informed about European and national market trends, food safety regulations and agrifood policies to guide organisations with a forward-thinking strategic approach
• Support marketing and communication efforts to highlight Luxembourg's agrifood innovation ecosystem and leadership in food innovation
Assess & Accelerate:
• Understand companies' innovation needs and assess how Luxinnovation's services align with their requirements
• Present a clear and complete Luxinnovation service path, offer tailored services or connect companies with other support providers
• Translate business needs into actionable strategies that accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices in the agrifood value chain
Connect:
• Develop and lead a network by connecting agrifood organisations, research centres and businesses to foster innovation and collaboration
• Facilitate strategic partnerships by linking companies with the right agrifood solutions and ensuring effective service delivery through client relationship management (CRM)
• Build and nurture relationships by ensuring ongoing engagement, satisfaction and a clear overview of all ongoing activities through continuous follow-up
• Enhance collaboration by connecting stakeholders and aligning ecosystem services across the agrifood sector
Fund:
• Help companies access State aid, R&D collaborations and adoption programmes related to the agrifood sector
• Strengthen engagement with companies to enhance their access to national and European agrifood support mechanisms
• Increase the number of agrifood companies accompanied by Luxinnovation in their innovation journey
• Improve the conversion rate from initial meetings to the adoption of Luxinnovation services
• Expand outreach to new companies to raise awareness and encourage engagement with innovation funding instruments
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Master's degree in engineering, agrifood sciences, business or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in the agrifood sector, bioeconomy, business development, consulting or ecosystem coordination
Specific competencies:
• Strong understanding of agrifood challenges, including decarbonisation, circular economy, digitalisation and sustainable agriculture
• Deep insight into how innovative strategies and sector-specific workflows can accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices
• Analytical skills to gather, document and prioritise business requirements and translate them into actionable strategies
• Excellent communication and networking skills, with the ability to build relationships across agrifood value chains
• Comfortable speaking in front of large audiences, engaging them effectively and tailoring presentations to specific audiences
• Adaptability in evolving environments, with a positive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work autonomously, take initiative and drive solutions with confidence
• Dynamic, results-oriented and proactive — ready to take ownership and drive change
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Languages:
Fluency in French, English and Luxembourgish or German is required.
IT skills:
Proficiency with standard office tools (MS Office suite). Familiarity with CRM platforms is an asset.

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Luxembourg's agrifood innovation ecosystem from within its national innovation agency. You will play a pivotal role in connecting agrifood SMEs and large companies to the resources, partnerships and funding they need to accelerate their digital and sustainable transformation.
You will work at the crossroads of policy, industry and research — collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture, sector associations and European networks. Your impact will be tangible: every company you accompany, every partnership you broker and every workgroup you lead will contribute directly to building a more competitive and sustainable agrifood sector in Luxembourg.
You will join a collaborative, forward-looking team that values autonomy, initiative and professional growth — in an environment where your ideas can translate into real, ecosystem-wide change.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
description:

Service: National Funding

Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vil du med på holdet? Så grib chancen og ansøg nu! Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: MSCA-DN PhD in quality of life & resilience in leukodystrophy (Tübingen, GE)
description:
Would you like to contribute to improving quality of life and resilience for people living with leukodystrophies and their families? You will develop patient-centred tools and investigate factors that influence coping, treatment experiences and quality of life across the lifespan. POLARIS doctoral network POLARIS is a European Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network focused on accelerating therapy development for leukodystrophies: rare genetic disorders affecting the brain's white matter. The network aims to strengthen the full translational pathway from disease mechanisms and model development to preclinical therapy testing, clinical readiness and patient-informed treatment priorities. To achieve this, POLARIS brings together expertise in leukodystrophy biology, advanced disease models, therapeutic innovation, biomarker development, clinical translation, patient engagement, and the ethical, regulatory and health-economic aspects of therapy development. The network will train a cohort of doctoral candidates in an international and interdisciplinary environment, combining academic research, industry-based preclinical development, secondments, network-wide training and transferable-skills development. PhD project For this position, the recruiting organisation is the University Hospital Tübingen (Eberhard Karls University of Tübingen), Germany. You will be embedded in the POLARIS consortium and work with experts in leukodystrophy, paediatric neurology, developmental psychopathology, resilience research and digital quality-of-life assessment. Leukodystrophies can have a profound and long-lasting impact on patients and their families. Yet current quality-of-life measures do not adequately capture the experiences of people with these rare diseases, particularly those who are severely affected or unable to communicate verbally. This project aims to address this gap and improve our understanding of what matters to patients and families throughout the course of the disease

The project has three connected research areas: Quality of life: evaluating existing quality-of-life measures and developing and validating a tool for patients and families across the lifespan, using qualitative research, consensus methods and quantitative validation in an international cohort. Risk and resilience: identifying factors associated with parental distress, coping and resilience, drawing on developmental and psychological research. Long-term outcomes: investigating how these factors relate to quality of life, treatment experiences and family coping over time, with the aim of identifying ways to strengthen resilience. A specific focus will be on families of children who are diagnosed before symptoms appear, for example through newborn screening, family screening or genetic testing. These families may face uncertainty about when symptoms will develop and difficult decisions about treatment. Understanding their experiences and support needs is important for developing patient-centred screening, monitoring and treatment pathways. Depending on your background and interests, the project can place greater emphasis on quality-of-life measurement or on risk and resilience research. You will develop your focus together with the research team. Planned secondments at the University of Oulu and the Anna Freud Centre will provide experience in digital quality-of-life assessment and psychosocial research. You will also engage with the European Leukodystrophy Association and other patient organisations to better understand the priorities of patients and families. The position is based in Tübingen, Germany, with academic enrolment through the Eberhard Karls University of Tübingen. You will pursue a PhD in a relevant discipline. You will independently contribute to the design and implementation of a multi-site, international research project. Your work will include qualitative and quantitative research, development and validation of quality-of-life measures, analysis

title: PHD Position
description:
PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
PhD PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
We are looking for a 4-year PhD candidate to join our nationally funded, multi-partner research consortium, Towards De-Novo Life. The main aim of this interdisciplinary project is to achieve minimal life based on chemical rather than biological components such as DNA, proteins or other macromolecules. Our PhD candidate will contribute by developing new microfluidic tools to work with micrometer-sized coacervate droplets, the compartments in which chemical replication, growth and evolution will take place.
PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
https://werkenbij.rug.nl/vacature/phd-position-using-microfluidics-to-observe-and-manipulate-coacervate-droplets-2327/
What are you going to do?
The de-novo synthesis of life requires integrating the essential features of life, which include replication (the ability to copy oneself), metabolism (promoting the formation of one's own components from material in the environment) and compartmentalization (keeping the internal components together and separate from the environment) into a system that is maintained out of equilibrium. Key to the creation of a minimal form of life is Darwinian evolution of the resulting synthetic cell-like systems. Serving as the compartments in our work are coacervate microdroplets, consisting of a very dense aqueous phase containing a high concentration of macromolecules. Because coacervates can exist in dilute aqueous phases without loss of droplet structure, they can act as cell-like spheres without the need of a membrane to contain their content.

title: Begeleider Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam  Assen - Meppel - Nooitgedacht
description:
Als begeleider in het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam werk je op verschillende locaties binnen Vanboeijen. Je hebt geen vaste werkplek, maar wél een vaste rol van betekenis: je wordt ingezet bij intensieve en complexe zorgvragen en brengt rust, richting en ontwikkeling. Je biedt onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding aan bewoners, sluit aan bij hun behoeften en draagt bij aan een veilige en stabiele leefomgeving.

Je herkent signalen, duidt gedrag en handelt vanuit de Vanboeijen Manier en Triple C. Is een opdracht afgerond? Dan ga je door naar een nieuwe locatie waar jouw kennis en ervaring opnieuw het verschil maken.

Daarnaast versterk je teams in de dagelijkse praktijk. Je coacht collega-begeleiders, deelt je expertise over methodieken en interventies en bent een voorbeeld in professioneel handelen, juist wanneer het spannend wordt. Samen met de gedragsdeskundige en zorgmanager stel je plannen van aanpak op, vertaal je observaties naar concrete doelen en blijf je scherp evalueren. Zo lever je een directe bijdrage aan duurzame verbetering van de zorg.

Toe aan meer inhoud, invloed en afwisseling in je werk als zorgprofessional? In het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam van Vanboeijen zet je jouw ervaring in waar die het hardst nodig is en maak je elke dag zichtbaar verschil.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: Service Coördinator (locatie Delft)
description:
Wat neem jij mee?
MBO-HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond
Circa 2 a 3 jaar ervaring in een servicegerichte, coördinerende of technische functie
Sterk organisatorisch vermogen en een gestructureerde werkwijze
Stressbestendigheid en heldere communicatieve vaardigheden
Ervaring met planningssystemen en of CRM-software is een plus


Ben jij degene die overzicht houdt, prioriteiten stelt en energie krijgt van het stroomlijnen van technische serviceprocessen. Dan is dit een rol met impact.
Je komt te werken bij een landelijk opererende specialist in het beheer van woning- en gebouwinstallaties. De organisatie richt zich op veiligheid, kwaliteit en naleving van wet en regelgeving, met een sterke focus op drinkwaterveiligheid en legionellapreventie. Tot de opdrachtgevers behoren onder meer zorginstellingen, ziekenhuizen, hotels, woningcorporaties en VvE. Alle werkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd conform geldende NEN normen, waardoor professionaliteit en kwaliteit centraal staan.

title: Pakketbezorger Oirschot, 40 uur, rijbewijs B is genoeg
description:
Ervaring als bezorger of chauffeur is welkom maar geen eis. Wij werken je in met een meeloopdag en begeleiding op de route.

Heb je wel ervaring in dezelfde of een soortgelijke functie, dan telt dat mee voor je inschaling in loonschaal C van de cao Beroepsgoederenvervoer. Aantonen doe je met loonstroken of een werkgeversverklaring. Ook ervaring uit een andere bedrijfstak telt mee (artikel 19 cao).

Wat wel nodig is: rijbewijs B, fulltime beschikbaar op maandag tot en met vrijdag, en geen vaste verplichting op werkdagen tussen 06:00 en 17:00.

Wij zijn Vanmark Logistics. Vanaf ons depot in Oirschot rijden wij elke dag vaste pakketroutes door Noord-Brabant, met een eigen wagenpark en een vaste ploeg chauffeurs.

Het werk: je rijdt een vaste route met een bestelbus. Rijbewijs B is genoeg, code 95 heb je niet nodig. Om 06:30 ben je op het depot. Je laadt je bus. Om 08:15 rijd je weg en rond 15:30 ben je klaar. Dat is negen uur tussen aanvang en einde dienst: acht betaalde uren plus een uur pauze. Een route ligt rond de 90 tot 130 stops.

Wat ons anders maakt: je teamleider rijdt zelf mee op de weg en de directie kent je naam. Is er iets, dan wordt het dezelfde dag opgelost in plaats van doorgeschoven. Overuren registreren wij vanaf de eerste dag en betalen wij uit met de cao-toeslag in dezelfde loonperiode. Geen verrekening achteraf, geen discussie over uren.

Je beloning gaat volgens de cao Beroepsgoederenvervoer, loonschaal C. Wat je verdient, hangt af van je aantoonbare ervaringsjaren, niet van wat je elders verdiende. Heb je nooit als bezorger gewerkt, dan is dat geen probleem: wij werken je in met een betaalde meeloopdag en begeleiding op de route.

Hoe het gaat als je solliciteert: je vult het formulier in, dat kost twee minuten. Je wordt dezelfde werkdag nog gebeld, ook als het antwoord nee is. Past het van twee kanten, dan loop je binnen vier dagen een dag mee op de route en weet je precies waar je aan begint. Daarna volgen het gesprek en het contract.

Kort samengevat wat wij vragen: rijbewijs B, je woont binnen 35 kilometer van het depot in Oirschot, en je bent alle vijf de dagen de hele dienst beschikbaar.

title: Office Manager
description:
Ervaring in een brede ondersteunende functie, bijvoorbeeld als Office Manager, Backoffice Medewerker of Management Assistent. Ervaring met contractadministratie, personeelsadministratie, urenregistratie, facturatie en managementondersteuning is gewenst. Affiniteit met HR, recruitment of de detacheringsbranche is een pre.


Hospitality is binnen deze functie belangrijk. Je bent een centraal aanspreekpunt voor het team en zorgt ervoor dat collega's, adviseurs, professionals en bezoekers zich welkom en geholpen voelen. Je bent servicegericht, betrokken en vindt het leuk om anderen te ontzorgen. Je ondersteunt onze adviseurs en het management in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden en ziet zelf wat er nodig is. Voor deze rol is het belangrijk dat je goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.


Je bent digitaal vaardig en kunt goed werken met Microsoft Office, waaronder Outlook, Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Daarnaast maak je je nieuwe systemen snel eigen en ben je gewend om met databases en administratieve systemen te werken. Je begrijpt hoe belangrijk het is dat gegevens volledig, correct en actueel worden vastgelegd.


Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met het opstellen en beheren van contracten, contractverlengingen, urenregistraties en declaraties en ondersteunt bij salarisadministratie, facturatie en audits. Ook zorg je voor een correcte administratie van kandidaten, professionals, cv's en vacatures.


Daarnaast beheer je de backoffice mailbox, ondersteun je bij facilitaire zaken, leveranciers, voorraadbeheer en de gezamenlijke lunch. Je draagt bij aan onboarding, personeelsactiviteiten, events, marketingactiviteiten en verschillende projecten.


We zoeken iemand die gastvrij, nauwkeurig, digitaal vaardig en proactief is. Je houdt overzicht, stelt prioriteiten, werkt zelfstandig en krijgt energie van organiseren, ondersteunen en ontzorgen.

Bij Jobeteer draait het om mensen, groei en werk dat echt bij je past. We zijn een ondernemende en groeiende organisatie met korte lijnen, veel energie en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Samen werken we iedere dag aan de verdere groei en professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Als Office Manager ben jij de organisatorische en administratieve spil van Jobeteer. Jij zorgt ervoor dat achter de schermen alles goed geregeld is en dat collega's en professionals op jou kunnen bouwen. Je hebt een brede en afwisselende functie waarin administratie, HR, office management, onboarding, events en managementondersteuning samenkomen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met het opstellen en beheren van contracten voor professionals en opdrachtgevers, contractverlengingen, urenregistraties, declaraties en ondersteuning bij facturatie en salarisadministratie. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat onze systemen en databases actueel zijn en dat kandidaten, professionals, cv's en vacatures correct worden geregistreerd.

Maar jouw rol gaat verder dan administratie. Je beheert de backoffice mailbox, onderhoudt contact met leveranciers en zorgt dat alles op kantoor goed geregeld is. Ook speel je een belangrijke rol bij de onboarding van nieuwe professionals en collega's en organiseer je personeelsuitjes, attenties en andere momenten die bijdragen aan de Jobeteer beleving.

Daarnaast ondersteun je het management bij verschillende werkzaamheden, projecten en events en help je waar nodig bij marketingactiviteiten. Omdat we blijven groeien, kijken we continu hoe onze processen slimmer en efficienter kunnen. Jij krijgt de ruimte om hierin mee te denken en verbeteringen zelf op te pakken.

We zoeken iemand die overzicht houdt, graag organiseert, zelfstandig werkt en verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en niet afwacht, maar het regelt. Geen dag is hetzelfde en juist die afwisseling maakt deze functie zo leuk.

Je werkt in een trailerwerkplaats in de regio Venlo, samen met ervaren collega's die jou begeleiden. Ervaring is niet nodig. Motivatie, interesse in techniek en de wil om te leren zijn het belangrijkst.


Een salaris tussen 2600 en 3200 bruto per maand.
Een fulltime baan van 40 uur per week in dagdienst.
25 vakantiedagen.
Een uitzendovereenkomst met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

Als assemblagemedewerker techniek leer je hoe je trailers demonteert, inspecteert, repareert en onderhoudt. Je krijgt een uitgebreid inwerktraject en groeit stap voor stap naar meer zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid.


Je demonteert trailers en beoordeelt welke onderdelen opnieuw gebruikt kunnen worden.
Je voert reparaties uit aan onder andere verlichting, remmen, opbouw en onderstel.
Je inspecteert en controleert traileronderdelen.
Je onderhoudt en organiseert de voorraad gebruikte onderdelen.
Je ondersteunt bij het gereedmaken van trailers voor inzet.
Je werkt volgens veiligheids- en kwaliteitsrichtlijnen.


Je hebt een praktische instelling en bent leergierig.
Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden.
Je bent betrouwbaar en werkt nauwkeurig.
Een heftruckcertificaat is een pre, of je bent bereid dit te behalen.
Je beheerst Nederlands, Engels of Duits voldoende om goed samen te werken.


Je komt terecht bij een bedrijf waar medewerkers echt centraal staan. De sfeer is persoonlijk, informeel en betrokken: jouw inzet wordt gezien én gewaardeerd. Bovendien krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
Hard werken wordt hier moeiteloos gecombineerd met plezier. Op vrijdag wordt de werkweek traditioneel om 16.30 uur afgesloten met een gezellig biertje en een praatje met collega's. Zin in wat actie? Daag je collega's uit voor een potje pingpong of trap een balletje op het eigen voetbalveld. Daarnaast worden er regelmatig gezellige feestjes, teamactiviteiten en BBQ's georganiseerd, waardoor de sterke teamspirit ook buiten werktijd voelbaar is.

title: International Regulatory Compliance Support (Dutch speaking)
description:
This role is for a curious learner with a keen interest in the growing world of international EPR (WEEE/e-waste, batteries, and packaging) and product environmental sustainability. You will be providing data management, support, and advisory services for our internal team and our clients. You will work on a wide range of topics and activities supporting our client base in compliance with these global laws.
Support the Amsterdam team with research, account management activities, engagement with national authorities across Europe.
Develop expertise over time on EPR systems, processes, and rules
Manage client-specific implementations of compliance requirements.
Liaise with national environmental compliance authorities and organizations in multiple countries to obtain information and arrange registrations
Maintain our compliance database, customer files, and other related information across several software applications
Work with data to complete client reporting requirements.
Candidate will have enough year of working experience to know what the candidate ise good at. It can be in any field, preferably in connection with data management (product or supply chain) or project management in any industry

A plus:
- Open to diverse work and educational backgrounds including environmental studies, legal, policy, engineering, international trade compliance, supply chain procurement, political science, international affairs, economics, business, finance, liberal arts, etc.
- Experience international trade and supply chain
- Experience with product compliance or audits
- Experience in databases and data management

Wij zijn een klein internationaal team van 8 personen in Amsterdam, met daarnaast een team van 12 personen in de VS. We werken veel met elkaar samen en houden ons allemaal bezig met verschillende onderwerpen.

We vinden het belangrijk om onze teamleden verder te ontwikkelen in een richting die goed bij hen past, bijvoorbeeld meer richting datamanagement of juist meer richting compliance- en regelgevingonderzoek. Tegelijkertijd doen we allemaal deels hetzelfde werk, zodat we elkaar kunnen helpen en werk van elkaar kunnen overnemen wanneer dat nodig is.

De regelgeving verandert voortdurend en al onze klanten zijn internationale bedrijven waar eveneens veel verandert. Dit maakt de functie erg afwisselend en dynamisch.
