title: 2 ledige stillinger som Veileder/Sosialkonsulent - NAV Bjerke
description:
Er du en person med pågangsmot og engasjement som ønsker å utgjøre en forskjell? Trives du i en givende arbeidshverdag med stor variasjon av oppgaver? Da kan du være den kollegaen vi ønsker oss. Hos oss kan du utgjøre en forskjell!

Vi har ledig to stillinger som veileder. Den ene stillingen er fast, mens den andre er midlertidig til 31.12.2027, med mulighet for forlengelse. Som veileder hos oss vil du ha ansvar for oppfølging av personer som har fått økonomisk sosialhjelp over lengre tid. Du vil samarbeide med dem, slik at de får bistanden de har behov for, trygg økonomi og varig tilknytning til arbeidslivet. Dette krever at du ser muligheter i alle sakene du følger opp. Det inngår dermed i et stort tverrfaglig felleskap og har som mål å sørge for at personer med sammensatte levekårsutfordringer får akkurat de tjenestene og rettighetene de har krav på og behov for.

Teamet behandler innkomne søknader om økonomisk sosialhjelp, følger opp dem som mottar ytelsen og lager planer som over tid fører til økonomisk selvstendighet for personene i målgruppen. Riktig kandidat vil kunne skape balansen mellom saksbehandlingen og den kvalitative og oppfølgingen av porteføljen i retning av varig tilknytning til arbeidsmarkedet.  

NAV Bjerke er et utviklingsorientert NAV-kontor med i overkant av 130 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere fordelt på 6 ulike avdelinger. NAV Bjerke holder til på Ulven, noen hundre meter fra Økern som er et knutepunkt for buss og T-bane. NAV Bjerkes hovedmål er at alle som har behov for tjenestene våre skal få muligheten til å jobbe gjennom kvalitativt god og behovsstyrt arbeidsrettet oppfølging. Den NAV-faglige kompetansen, altså den arbeids- og sosialfaglige kompetansen, på kontoret er meget god og skal framover ytterligere styrkes og utvikles. Vi har fokus på innovasjon og reell brukermedvirkning i en stadig mer digital hverdag.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • ansvar for saksbehandling etter lov om sosiale tjenester i NAV, fremdrift, kartlegging og utvikling i egen portefølje 
  • gi råd og veiledning knyttet til NAVs tjenestetilbud, herunder nav.no, NAV-loven, Lov om sosiale tjenester, forvaltningsloven og folketrygdloven 
  • gi helhetlig brukeroppfølging, engasjere, motivere og i samarbeid med brukere kartlegge individuelle muligheter, utarbeide planer og tilrettelegge for arbeid og aktivitet
  • endringstakten er for tiden svært høy og det må derfor påregnes endringer i arbeidsoppgavene
Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • 3-årig utdanning fra høyskole eller universitet innenfor sosial, helsefaglig eller annen relevant kompetanse. Særlig relevant erfaring kan kompensere for deler av utdanningskravet
  • erfaring i bruk av IKT-systemer som arbeidsverktøy og erfaring innen digital kommunikasjon
  • erfaring innen kommunikasjon, veiledning og samhandling med mennesker i en vanskelig situasjon
  • erfaring innen oppfølging av egen brukerportefølje
  • erfaring fra saksbehandling etter Lov om sosiale tjenester i Fasit
  • forståelse av virksomhetens mål og resultatkrav
  • meget godt skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne
  • god kjennskap til aktuelle lovverk
  • erfaring fra tilsvarende arbeid ved NAV-kontor
  • vi benytter norsk som arbeidsspråk og søkere må beherske norsk meget godt skriftlig og muntlig

Vi ønsker at du forteller hvordan din erfaring kvalifiserer deg til denne stillingen i søknaden og vi ønsker at du matcher din erfaring mot alle punktene som er listet opp under kvalifikasjoner. Hvorfor er nettopp du best kvalifisert til denne stillingen? Søknader med tydelig refleksjon vil vektlegges i utplukk av kandidater til intervju.

 

Personlige egenskaper
  • du må først og fremst være en teamspiller som også klarer å ta selvstendige grep og vurderinger    
  • du er endringsvillig, engasjert og resultatorientert
  • du må ha evnen til å tenke kreativt og nyskapende
  • du har evnen til å inspirere og motivere, og ser muligheter fremfor begrensinger
  • du jobber målrettet og trives i en hektisk hverdag
  • du må arbeide systematisk og helhetlig og kunne prioritere mellom ulike arbeidsoppgaver  
  • motivasjon for stillingens arbeidsoppgaver samt personlig egnethet for å løse disse vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Lønnsplassering i lønnstrinn 34–43, tilsvarende årslønn fra kr 633 200 til kr 740 600 i 100 % stilling etter Oslo kommunes regulativ, avhengig av ansiennitet.
  • Meningsfylte og selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver i en organisasjon med svært viktige samfunnsoppdrag
  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Gode tjenestepensjons- og forsikringsordninger i Oslo pensjonsforsikring

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Bjerke – en bydel for alle

Bydel Bjerke ligger ved Groruddalens utløp, og store deler av bydelen grenser mot marka med badevann, turstier og skiløyper som gir mange muligheter for tur- og friluftsliv hele året. Med god dekning av offentlig kommunikasjon er det også kort vei til Oslo sentrum. Bydelen har rundt 30 000 innbyggere og er blant bydelene som har hatt den største befolkningsveksten de siste årene. På bakgrunn av en rekke nye utbyggingsområder og tilflytting av mange barnefamilier forventes denne befolkningsveksten å fortsette i årene som kommer.

Bydel Bjerke er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon, og våre tjenester bygger på en idé om at alle bydelens innbyggere skal oppleve mestring og være «sjef i eget liv». Med vår visjon «Bydel Bjerke – en bydel for alle» jobber vi for å skape et godt lokalsamfunn, med gode levekår for alle våre innbyggere.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

title: Er du vår neste Assisterende restaurantsjef – med ønske om å vokse sammen med oss?
description:
Brennende opptatt av god service, vertskap, mat og vin? Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å lede driften i dag, og som på sikt ønsker å ta enda mer ansvar.

 

Vi søker en engasjert, strukturert og tilstedeværende assisterende restaurantsjef til teamet på Biologen Herdla. Hos oss blir en sentral oppgave å bidra til at gjestene skal føle seg ivaretatt og velkomne fra første stund.

Dette er en fantastisk mulighet for deg som trives i en operativ lederrolle på gulvet, men som samtidig har lyst til å utvikle deg videre. For den rette personen er vi opptatt av å legge til rette for faglig vekst, med gode muligheter for å ta mer overordnet ansvar etter hvert.

Om Biologen Herdla

Biologen Herdla ligger idyllisk til helt ytterst på Askøy, omkranset av storslått natur og med panoramautsikt over Hjeltefjorden og Herdlefjorden. Vår historie strekker seg tilbake til tiden som marinbiologisk forskningsstasjon, og i dag driver vi et varmt, personlig og stemningsfylt boutique hotell.

 

Hos oss forenes den unike kysthistorien med førsteklasses mat- og vinopplevelser. Vi brenner for lokale råvarer, et nøye sammensatt vinkart og det ekte, rause vestlandske vertskapet. Å jobbe her betyr lavere skuldre, spektakulære omgivelser og en hverdag fylt med matglede, spennende gjester og fantastiske kolleger.

Din rolle som assisterende restaurantsjef

I det daglige vil du jobbe tett sammen med daglig leder og kjøkkenet for å skape magiske øyeblikk for gjestene og en trygg, inspirerende hverdag for teamet.

 

Sentrale oppgaver:

  • Være til stede i driften: Spre trygghet, god energi og passe på at servicen flyter sømløst i sal og restaurant.
  • Det gode vertskapet: Bidra til at alle som besøker oss møtes med varme, faglig tyngde og kvalitet i alle ledd.
  • Kvalitet og detaljer: Være opptatt av de små og store detaljene som gjør at vi leverer topp kvalitet i alle ledd.
  • Daglig tilrettelegging og økonomi: Hjelpe til med vaktlister, varebestillinger, gode rutiner, dagsoppgjør og være delaktig i månedsavslutninger med varetelling.
  • Innspill og utvikling: Være med å forme meny-, vin- og drikkekonsepter, samt planlegge selskaper og arrangementer sammen med resten av lederteamet.
  • Spille laget godt: Møte hver dag med godt humør og entusiasme, og løfte teamet i samme retning mot felles mål.
Hvem ser vi etter?

Du har gjerne erfaring fra restaurant, hotell eller servering, enten som hovmester, skiftleder eller som en erfaren servitør som føler seg klar for å ta neste steg inn i lederrollen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss om du:

  • Har et brennende hjerte for god service, god mat og spennende vin.
  • Har god tall- og økonomiforståelse, med blikk for struktur i driften.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som leder gjennom nærvær, humør og god kommunikasjon.
  • Er ryddig og strukturert, men takler at det koker litt i helgene med et smil.
  • Drivs av å begeistre gjesten og skape de beste opplevelsene.
  • Ønsker å lære mer, bygge karriere over tid og vokse i faget sammen med oss.
  • Har tilgang på bil (en fordel med tanke på beliggenhet og arbeidstider).
  • Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig – da en viktig del av hverdagen handler om tett dialog med våre norske gjester, opplæring av teamet og enkelte administrative oppgaver.
Hva vi tilbyr
  • En unik, spennende og sentral lederstilling på et av Askøys vakreste steder.
  • Tydelige utviklingsmuligheter: Et uformelt og raust miljø hvor vi satser på folkene våre og heier fram intern karrierebygging.
  • Faglig påfyll innen vertskap, ledelse og vinkunnskap (inkludert tilgang til vår egen vinkjeller).
  • Stor frihet til å komme med egne idéer og være med på å forme konseptet videre.
  • Et inkluderende, engasjert og sosialt kollegium hvor vi løfter i flokk.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser etter avtale.
Klar for å bli en del av laget på Herdla?

Er du nysgjerrig på rollen, ønsker mer informasjon om mulighetene hos Biologen Herdla, eller bare vil ta en helt uforpliktende prat? Da hører vi veldig gjerne fra deg!

 

Send inn din CV og en kort tekst om deg selv, eller ta direkte kontakt med vår rekrutteringspartner i Randstad.

 

Camilla Johnsen Vågstøl, Seniorrådgiver, Randstad, E-post: camilla.vagstol@randstad.no

 

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg!

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BIOLOGEN DRIFT AS

Biologen Herdla er et unikt boutique-hotell og serveringssted idyllisk plassert helt ytterst på Askøy, med panoramautsikt over Hjeltefjorden. Stedets historie går tilbake til 1920-tallet som marinbiologisk forskningsstasjon.

I dag forener vi denne historiske sjarmen med førsteklasses mat- og vinopplevelser, kurs- og konferansefasiliteter og ekte vestlandsk vertskap. Vi brenner for lokale råvarer, god vin og uforglemmelige opplevelser for våre gjester. Hos Biologen får du et engasjert, uformelt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø hvor faglig kvalitet, matglede og samhold står i sentrum.

description:
Hvordan skaper vi tillit når avstanden mellom mennesker øker? Hvordan møtes vi når perspektivene står langt fra hverandre? Og hvordan kan dialog bidra til å forebygge konflikt og styrke demokratiet?

Dette er spørsmål Nansen Fredssenter har arbeidet med i mer enn tre tiår. Gjennom praktisk freds- og dialogarbeid i Norge og internasjonalt har vi utviklet en unik tilnærming til dialog som verktøy for å bygge tillit, transformere konflikter og skape konstruktive møter mellom mennesker.

Nå søker Nansen Fredssenter en seniorrådgiver dialog som vil være med på å anvende, formidle og videreutvikle dette arbeidet.

 

Rollen

Som seniorrådgiver dialog vil du arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, fag og samfunn. 

Du blir en viktig faglig bærer av Nansen Fredssenters dialogmetodikk og bidrar til å videreutvikle både metodikk, faglig innhold og nye prosjekter.

Rollen gir stor grad av frihet og selvstendighet. Derfor ser vi etter deg som tar initiativ, ser muligheter og får ting til å skje. Du må trives med å drive eget arbeid fremover, etablere relasjoner og omsette ideer til konkrete aktiviteter og prosjekter - i Norge og internasjonalt.

 

Du vil blant annet:

  • koordinere, gjennomføre og videreutvikle kurs, seminarer og undervisning – fysiske og digitale
  • lede og fasilitere dialogprosesser i Norge og internasjonalt
  • anvende, formidle og bidra til å videreutvikle Nansen Fredssenters dialogmetodikk
  • initiere, utvikle og lede prosjekter fra idé til gjennomføring og rapportering - inkludert søknader og finansiering
  • utvikle samarbeid og bygge relasjoner med relevante fagmiljøer, organisasjoner og samfunnsaktører
  • representere Nansen Fredssenter nasjonalt og internasjonalt

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en selvgående og personlig engasjert person med faglig tyngde og sterk relasjonell kompetanse.

Du følger med på samfunnsutviklingen nasjonalt og internasjonalt, og interesserer deg for menneskene og mekanismene som former våre liv og samtid. Du er komfortabel med kompleksitet og ulike perspektiver, og har evnen til å skape tillit også når utgangspunktet er krevende.

Samtidig har du gjennomføringskraft. Du trenger ikke å bli fortalt hva neste steg er - du ser det selv og tar ansvar for å komme videre. Du er robust og tåler perioder med ubekvemme arbeidstider, helgearbeid og reising.

 

Vi legger særlig vekt på:

  • erfaring med prosjekt- og prosessledelse
  • svært gode formidlings- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • evne til å arbeide selvstendig, ta initiativ og drive prosesser fremover
  • erfaring fra eller interessen for internasjonale og tverrkulturelle sammenhenger
  • evne til å bygge tillit og skape gode relasjoner på tvers av kulturer og perspektiver
  • et tydelig og genuint samfunnsengasjement

Du har:

  • relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne på masternivå
  • flere års relevant arbeidserfaring
  • erfaring fra ett eller flere relevante fagområder, eksempelvis dialog- og konfliktarbeid, demokrati- og menneskerettighetsarbeid, integrering, utdanning, forskning, offentlig sektor, sivilsamfunn eller internasjonalt arbeid
  • god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er en fordel om du har:

  • erfaring fra freds- og dialogarbeid
  • erfaring med prosjekt- og/eller prosessledelse
  • andre språkferdigheter
  • relevante faglige nettverk

Vi er opptatt av mangold i perspektiver og erfaringer, og oppfordrer kandidater med ulik faglig og profesjonell bakgrunn til å søke. Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

 

Hvorfor Nansen Fredssenter?

Hos oss får du muligheten til å bruke kompetansen din i arbeid med tydelig samfunnsmessig betydning. Du blir en del av et nasjonalt og internasjonalt anerkjent fagmiljø med mer enn 30 års erfaring innen dialog, konflikttransformasjon og fredsarbeid, samtidig som du får stor frihet til å påvirke hvordan arbeidet utvikles videre.

Du får arbeide på tvers av fag, kulturer og landegrenser med problemstillinger som er aktuelle, komplekse og viktige. Rollen gir en unik mulighet til å bidra til varig endring gjennom dialogprosesser som styrker tillit, forståelse og samarbeid mellom mennesker og samfunn.

Nansen Fredssenter kjennetegnes av et sterkt faglig fellesskap, et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø, og et engasjement som gjennomsyrer hele organisasjonen. Her møter du kollegaer som brenner for samfunnsoppdraget, som deler kunnskap og erfaringer, og som er opptatt av å støtte hverandre i arbeidet med å skape positive samfunnsendringer.

Vi ønsker mangfold i erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner, og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater med ulik bakgrunn til å søke. Hos oss verdsettes ulike perspektiver og bakgrunn som en styrke, fordi gode dialogprosesser bygger på nettopp mangfold, nysgjerrighet og gjensidig respekt.

 

Arbeidssted: Lillehammer
Stilling: Fast
Søknadsfrist: 1. november 2026

 

For spørsmål om stillingen eller rekrutteringsprosessen, kontakt Kristine Bugge Lie Owe, seniorrådgiver i Jefferson Wells på epost: kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no eller +47 40 72 40 05.

 
 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nansen Fredssenter er et ledende fagmiljø innen dialog, fredsbygging og demokratisk deltakelse. Gjennom dialogprosesser, kompetanseutvikling og internasjonalt samarbeid arbeider vi for å styrke tillit, inkludering og konstruktiv håndtering av uenighet. Vårt mål er å bidra til samfunn der mennesker med ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og interesser kan møtes, lytte til hverandre og skape løsninger sammen.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a position as PhD Research Fellow in bioinformatics and computational biology available at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.

 

The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.

 

The fellowship period is three years and is free of any teaching obligations. No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

 

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen; https://epigenahuscom.wordpress.com/) at the University of Oslo, Ahus Campus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). It is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and provides an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.

 

 

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team of molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning model that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The candidate will work with researchers at UiO, Ahus, and Oslo University Hospital (OUS), as well as by international collaborators in the United States. The research conducted during the appointment is expected to culminate in a PhD thesis submitted to the University of Oslo.

 

We seek a highly motivated candidate with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, data mining, machine learning, and computational programming. The ideal candidate will hold a Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and human genetics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of information, including the biophysical principles of protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular focus will be on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to improve both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.

 

The PhD research fellow will primarily focus on developing data mining methods such as network analysis in 3D genome regulation that integrate diverse biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional non-coding mutations and their targets in long-distance regions. Subsequently, the predictions will be validated in cancer by using both in vivo and in vitro experimental data.

 

Depending on the candidate's qualifications and the progress of the project, there may be an opportunity to undertake a 3–6-month research visit to the laboratory of one of our international collaborators in the United States. This visit will provide advanced training in computational approaches for studying single-cell 3D genome regulation and further strengthen the international collaboration.


What skills are important in this role?

Candidates for the PhD fellowships will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

 

Required qualifications:

  • To be admitted to the PhDprogramme at the University ofOslo, an applicant musthave a five-year master'sdegree or equivalent studiesthat the faculty have recognised as forminga sufficient basisfor admission.
  • The facultiesmay stipulate additional admission requirements.
  • To be employed as aPhD ResearchFellow, admission toa doctoral program is required,or a binding agreementfor admission must be in place. Normally, one must apply foradmission to a Ph.D. program within3 months after thestart of the research project leading tothe Ph.D. degree.
  • Good written and oral Englishproficiency.
  • Master's degree in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with an MSc in physics, computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics are also encouraged to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong interest and aptitude for learning molecular biology and the human genome.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills. 
  • Documented experience in big data analysis.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis.

 

Language requirement:

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
  • https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

 

Grade requirements:

  • The average grade point for the course in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better (Norwegian educational system)
  • The average grade point for the course in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master's thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

 

 

 

Personal qualities 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.
  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

 

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis.
  • Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications). 
  • Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis.aaa

 

Employment in the position is basedon a comprehensive assessment of allqualification requirements applicable tothe position, including 

personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningfultasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing toknowledge development, education, andenlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, andknowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasantand stimulatingwork environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and careeropportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes,with beneficialmortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as DoctoralResearch Fellow, position code1017 in the salary range of NOK 550 800 -600 000, depending oncompetence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent isdeducted in statutory contributions to theState Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefitsof working in thepublic sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • A copy of the Master's thesis, a list of publications and academic works (maximum 5) that you wish to be considered by the committee
  • Certified copies of the original Bachelor and Master's degree diploma and the transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • Contact information for at least 3 references (name, relation to the candidate, institutional email address and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Contact information 

For further information, please contact:

  • Junbai Wang, junbai.wang@medisin.uio.no

 

For questions regarding Jobbnorge, please

  • Maren Retterstøl Olaisen, HR advisor, m.r.olaisen@medisin.uio.no

Place of service:

Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen)

University of Oslo, Ahus campus

1748 Lørenskog


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: Resepsjonist
description:
Resepsjonist – fast nattevakt 80 %

Thon Hotel Notodden

Vil du være den som sørger for at gjestene våre får en trygg, hyggelig og god start på dagen – også når resten av byen sover?

Thon Hotel Notodden søker nå en fast nattevakt til resepsjonen.

Hos oss er gjesten alltid i sentrum, og vi er stolte av å skape gode hotellopplevelser – fra gjesten sjekker inn, til de reiser videre med et smil. Vi ønsker oss derfor en trygg, selvstendig og serviceinnstilt person som trives med å jobbe på egen hånd og som liker å ha ansvar.

Som nattevakt hos oss får du en variert og viktig jobb

Natten på hotell handler om langt mer enn å sitte i resepsjonen. Du er hotellets ansikt utad når de fleste andre sover, og har ansvar for at gjestene våre føler seg trygge og ivaretatt gjennom natten.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Betjene resepsjonen og ta imot gjester som kommer sent

  • Håndtere innsjekk, utsjekk og gjestehenvendelser

  • Sørge for god service og være tilgjengelig for gjestene gjennom natten

  • Håndtere telefoner og forespørsler

  • Følge opp eventuelle hendelser og situasjoner som oppstår

  • Ha oversikt over hotellet og bidra til trygghet og sikkerhet gjennom natten

  • Utføre rutiner knyttet til nattarbeid og dagsoppgjør

  • Kontrollere og klargjøre fellesområder

  • Sørge for at hotellet er ryddig og innbydende til morgenen

  • Forberede og klargjøre frokosten

  • Sørge for at frokostområdet er klart når de første gjestene kommer

  • Ta imot våre morgenfugler og bidra til en hyggelig start på dagen

  • Følge opp tidlige utsjekker og gjester som skal tidlig videre

  • Utføre andre forefallende oppgaver som naturlig hører til en nattevakt på hotell

Frokosten er viktig for oss!

For oss er frokosten en viktig del av hotellopplevelsen. Den skal ikke bare være på plass – den skal være innbydende, ryddig og gi gjestene våre en god start på dagen.

Som nattevakt vil du derfor ha en viktig rolle i å gjøre frokosten klar før resten av hotellet våkner. Du må like å ha orden, være nøye og ha et øye for detaljer.

Når den første gjesten kommer inn til frokost, skal det være hyggelig å møte dagen hos oss.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du passer godt hos oss hvis du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og imøtekommende

  • Trives med å jobbe selvstendig

  • Er ansvarsbevisst og trygg på å ta egne avgjørelser

  • Har godt humør – også på natt

  • over 20 år

  • Har sans for orden og detaljer

  • Takler uforutsette situasjoner på en rolig og profesjonell måte

  • Liker å møte mennesker fra mange forskjellige steder

  • Forstår betydningen av god gjesteservice

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med nattarbeid og liker å ha ansvar

Hotellerfaring er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav. Det viktigste for oss er hvem du er, hvordan du møter mennesker og at du har lyst til å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.

Hos oss blir du en del av laget

Thon Hotels legger stor vekt på menneskene som jobber på hotellene, og på mulighetene for utvikling internt. Norlandia Hotel Group beskriver også medarbeiderne som sin viktigste ressurs og legger stor vekt på å skape ekstraordinære gjesteopplevelser og gjøre det lille ekstra for gjesten.

På Thon Hotel Notodden blir du en del av et hyggelig hotellteam hvor vi spiller hverandre gode og jobber sammen for å gi gjestene våre en best mulig opplevelse.

Vi er et hotell med 60 rom, midt i sentrum av Notodden, og har både fritidsreisende, forretningsreisende, konferansegjester og andre besøkende gjennom året.

Vi kan tilby

  • Fast stilling som nattevakt

  • En selvstendig og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø

  • Møte med mange forskjellige mennesker

  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg innen hotell og reiseliv

  • En jobb hvor du faktisk gjør en forskjell for gjestenes hotellopplevelse

Arbeidstid: Natt – etter oppsatt turnus.

Arbeidssted: Thon Hotel Notodden, Torvet 8, 3674 Notodden.

⭐ Er du vår nye nattevakt?

Hvis du liker å jobbe når andre sover, trives med ansvar og synes det er givende å sørge for at andre får en god natt og en enda bedre morgen – da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Vi behandler søknader fortløpenede, og gjennomfører intervjuer løpende.

Ansettelse: snarest

Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om deg selv og hvorfor du har lyst til å bli en del av teamet på Thon Hotel Notodden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Norlandia Hotel Group drifter totalt 37 enheter i Norge og Sverige.

Med fokus på våre ansatte er vi et av Nordens beste hotelldrifts selskap. Vi har ett hovedfokus, å skape god gjeste- og medarbeider opplevelser. At våre gjester er fornøyde og at du som medarbeider trives på arbeidsplassen, har alt å si for vår felles suksess.

Thon Hotel Notodden eises av Norlandia Hotel Group og drives i partnerskap med Thon Hotels. Hotellet er kjent for sitt sterke fokus på god gjeste service, høy kvalitet og en fantastisk frokost opplevelse som gir gjestene en best mulig start på dagen.

Hotellet er nylig renovert, og fremstår i dag som et moderne, innbydende og komfortabelt hotell for både forretningsreisende og fritids gjester. Med beliggenhet midt i Notodden sentrum, er vi et naturlig valg for gjester som besøker regionen.

Hos oss møter du et engasjert team som er stolte av arbeidsplassen sin, og som hver dag jobber for å skape gode opplevelser for våre gjester.

title: Founding Growth Marketer
description:
Who we are looking for

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to build Birdsview's growth engine from the ground up, the person who turns "we have a great product" into a steady flow of qualified pipeline. AI first person.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding Growth Marketer, you will be the engine of our international growth. The role is hands-on: you'll use AI tools to build and test campaigns across channels, turn technical value into content that resonates with engineers and asset owners, run experiments to find what actually converts, and hand qualified leads to our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly formed marketing function, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the engine
    You'll design and implement our full growth marketing engine, taking a foundational role in shaping our strategy.

  • Own demand generation
    Own demand generation across content, paid, and organic channels, directly impacting qualified lead flow to sales. You're measured on qualified leads reaching sales.

  • Find the message that lands
    Test positioning against our different customer segments; engineers, contractors, asset owners and find the one we can scale. Nobody has the answer yet.

  • Work the funnel with sales
    Hand qualified leads to our sales team, and use what they hear back to sharpen the next campaign.

  • Build the measurement
    Set up tracking, reporting, and analytics to measure performance, identify effective strategies, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Make the technical obvious
    Leverage AI tools to create and test innovative campaigns that translate complex technical value into resonant messages for our target audience.

What we're looking for

  • AI-first, systematic and test-driven. You run experiments, read the data, and a campaign that flops doesn't slow you down.

  • Proven ability to build and run a complete growth engine: lead generation, content, paid campaigns, organic channels.

  • Skills in setting up tracking, reporting and analytics, so performance is measured rather than asserted.

  • Experience developing, testing and refining positioning and messaging, in collaboration with sales and leadership.

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B growth or marketing, ideally in a startup or scale-up. Hands-on and results-oriented, this is a building role.

  • Fluent English; Norwegian is an advantage.

  • Based in Bergen or Oslo, or willing to relocate.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary and equity - become an owner.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Location
    Work in Bergen or Oslo with a fast-moving, hands-on team. Excellent working facilities at StartupLab centrally located in both cities.

View the full details for the job here.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Help us take Birdsview global! Birdsview is building the "MRI for concrete", turning scans into clear answers about what's inside a structure, without breaking it open. Survey companies, structural engineers, and construction companies in 9 countries already use it in the field. title: Founding Business Development Representative
description:
Who we are looking for

As our Founding Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be the engine behind our sales pipeline - the first Birdsview person many prospects talk to. You'll open doors across Europe and beyond, working closely with our sales team to turn interest into qualified opportunities.

Birdsview - Prolonging the lifetime of the built world

Birdsview is a Norwegian technology company on a mission to change the way we preserve critical infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and secure future.

Infrastructure is one of society’s most important assets. It includes the buildings we live in, the bridges we cross and the power grid that provides us with electricity. These structures are aging rapidly, and solutions that help preserve and secure critical infrastructure are now needed more than ever.

Birdsview's state-of-the-art technology combines radar (GPR), lidar, and AI to visualize what’s inside structures without destructive interventions. This allows for efficient and cost-effective inspection and monitoring of our most precious infrastructures - and enables clear, user-friendly visualizations that enhance understanding, extend asset lifespan, and promote material reuse - ultimately reducing costs and CO₂ emissions.

We are 17 people, we have customers in 9 countries, and we raised NOK 40.5 million from leading Nordic VC's to scale internationally.

About the job and why it matters

Much of concrete inspection today still relies on manual methods and fragmented, ageing non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. You will help structural engineers, contractors, surveying specialists, and asset owners see clearly what is hidden inside the concrete. New critical data, faster inspections, and real cost savings are why they want our technology in their daily projects.

As a Founding BDA, you will be the engine behind our international growth. The role is to reach the right prospects, understand the problems they face, and show them what our technology does. You will build target account lists in HubSpot, make cold calls, drive LinkedIn and email outreach, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. This is a foundational role in a newly established sales team, where you will have a direct impact on our strategy, processes, and success.

  • Build the target list
    Research accounts across Europe and North America, and find the people who actually make the decision.

  • Run outbound
    Personalised outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn - plus follow-up on inbound leads and contacts from conferences.

    Qualify opportunities, book meetings for the sales team, and keep our CRM clean enough that we can see what works.

  • Know the product and the market
    Deeply enough to have real conversations, not scripted ones.

  • Sharpen the message
    Feed back what you hear from prospects so marketing can build on it.

What we're looking for

  • Hunger and dedication to win.

  • Clear writing, thoughtful research, and confidence on the phone.

  • Organised and self-driven.

  • Comfortable working in a CRM. We use HubSpot.

  • At home where the process is still being figured out, you're helping figuring it out.

  • Fluent in English. Norwegian, German, Spanish or French is a strong plus given where our customers are.

Why this is interesting

  • Top-tier colleagues
    Work alongside leading people in a supportive and ambitious team culture, with regular social events and company trips.

  • Build it yourself
    Be a foundational member, directly shaping our international sales strategy and playbook.

  • Room to grow
    We're building the commercial team right now. What you own in a year depends on what you build in the first six months.

  • Impact
    Make a tangible impact on preserving critical infrastructure and fostering a circular economy.

  • Compensation
    Competitive salary, commission, and equity - become an owner.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen), Campus Ahus, University of Oslo.
The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.
The appointment is for a period of three years. In accordance with University of Oslo regulations, no individual may be appointed to more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship period at the University.


The position is based at the Department of Clinical Molecular Biology (EpiGen) at the University of Oslo, Campus Ahus, Lørenskog. EpiGen is a joint research unit established by the University of Oslo (UiO) and Akershus University Hospital (Ahus). The department is actively involved in several major national research initiatives and offers an outstanding research environment with state-of-the-art laboratories, advanced computational infrastructure, and dedicated research facilities. The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway.
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research team comprising molecular biologists, bioinformaticians, physicists, and pathologists. The project aims to develop a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates diverse biological data—including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenomic features, and three-dimensional (3D) genome organization—to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions in cancer. The postdoctoral researcher will collaborate closely with students, PhD candidates, researchers, and national and international partners. The work is expected to result in high-quality scientific publications as well as broadly applicable computational resources, such as open-source software and bioinformatics tools.

 

We seek a highly motivated and ambitious researcher with a strong background in molecular biology, human genetics/genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, data mining, and computational programming, including software or package development. The ideal candidate will hold a PhD in bioinformatics or computational biology. Applicants with a PhD in related disciplines, such as computer science, physics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a closely related quantitative field, are also encouraged to apply, provided they demonstrate a strong interest in and commitment to applying computational methods to molecular biology and human genetics/genomics.


More about the position

The project aims to develop novel computational methods and tools for predicting functional non-coding mutations in the cancer genome. These methods will integrate diverse sources of biological information, including the biophysical principles governing protein–DNA interactions, the genetic and epigenetic features of DNA sequences, and the three-dimensional (3D) organization of the genome and its regulatory landscape. A particular emphasis will be placed on integrating multi-omics data generated from single-cell experiments to enhance both predictive accuracy and biological interpretability.


The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will primarily focus on developing a biophysically interpretable machine learning framework that integrates multiple layers of biological information, including transcription factor (TF)–DNA interactions, epigenetic features, and 3D genome organization, to identify functional long-range gene regulatory interactions from in vivo data. The candidate will also be involved in the validation of predictions from cancer genomes.
 

Throughout the fellowship, the Postdoctoral Research Fellow will be supported by a structured career development plan. This may include opportunities to teach and supervise bioinformatics students, present research at international conferences, and undertake research visits to leading international laboratories. The fellowship is designed to equip the candidate with the scientific expertise, professional skills, and international research experience needed to pursue a competitive research career within or beyond academia. The University of Oslo (UiO) is committed to supporting the Fellow's career development by providing ongoing mentoring and access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral appointment.


About the position

You must have
To be appointed as a postdoctoral fellow, a doctoral degree is required.

  • Good written and oral English proficiency.
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, or other relevant research fields to the project. The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defense are eligible for appointment.
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the project.
  • Documented knowledge of statistical theory and methods, data mining, and machine learning methods.
  • Documented shell script, R, Python, and C programming skills.
  • Documented experience in big data analysis and computational tool/package development.
  • Documented experience in high-throughput sequencing data analysis or computational genome regulation.
     

Personal qualities
 

  • Academic and personal ability to finish tasks on time
  • Ability to work either independently or collaboratively in an interdisciplinary team
  • Self-motivated to learn, easily adapted to new tasks, and interested in solving challenging scientific problems.

  • Good communication skills and openness to new perspectives

     

Desired qualifications
Experience with ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq/scATAC-seq, RNA-seq/scRNA-seq, WGS, WGBS, or Hi-C data analysis
Experience in computational genome studies (e.g., TF-DNA interactions, gene networks, DNA mutations, and histone modifications).
Experience with integrated multi-omics data analysis and software/package tool development

 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.
 


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours. A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in the position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352, in a salary range from NOK 595000 to 679000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Application cover letter (statement of motivation and research interests)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - a complete of scientific publications)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works (maximum 5; pdf files) that you wish to be considered by the committee
  • Certified copies of the original Master's and PhD diplomas and the transcripts of records
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • Contact information for at least 3 references (name, relation to the candidate, institutional email address and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

title: BPA assistent søkes til aktiv og glad gutt på 11 år – Drammen, Åssiden
description:
Vi søker en trygg, ansvarsfull og aktiv BPA assistent til vår hyggelige gutt på 11 år som bor sammen med familien sin på Åssiden i Drammen.

Han er en blid og sosial gutt som liker å være sammen med andre. Han er veldig glad i å være ute og ønsker å være aktiv, og vi ser derfor etter en BPA assistent, som kan bidra til en trygg, men samtidig morsom og innholdsrik hverdag.

Han liker blant annet å være ute, være sammen med dyr, huske, spille litt piano og synge. Han kan si noen ord og korte setninger, men har begrenset evne til kommunikasjon og trenger derfor en voksen som er tålmodig, oppmerksom og flink til å forstå hans behov og signaler.

Om ham

Han har autisme og moderat psykisk utviklingshemming. Han trenger hjelp og veiledning i de fleste deler av hverdagen.

Han har ikke tilstrekkelig forståelse for fare og trenger derfor tett oppfølging og en voksen som tar ansvar for sikkerheten hans. Det er viktig at du er oppmerksom, trygg og i stand til å handle raskt dersom det oppstår situasjoner som krever det.

Han klarer å gå på toalettet selv og kan tørke seg, men trenger fortsatt påminnelser og veiledning, blant annet om hva han skal gjøre og om håndvask.

Han trenger også hjelp til blant annet:

  • personlig hygiene og påminnelser i hverdagen

  • matlaging og tilrettelegging rundt måltider

  • å komme seg trygt ut på aktiviteter

  • aktiviteter og lek

  • å være sammen med andre

  • struktur og veiledning gjennom dagen

  • å ivareta sikkerheten hans

Arbeidstid

Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig være:

  • ettermiddager og kvelder

  • helger

  • skole- og feriedager/fridager

  • det kan også bli aktuelt med enkelte nattevakter etter avtale

En viktig del av jobben vil være å finne på og gjennomføre aktiviteter sammen med ham, særlig utendørs aktiviteter. Vi ønsker en BPA assistent som liker å være aktiv og som kan bidra til at han får oppleve mestring, glede og gode opplevelser.


Vi ser etter deg som

  • er trygg, tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • tar jobben og ansvaret på alvor

  • er stabil og pålitelig

  • liker å være aktiv og være ute

  • er oppmerksom og kan ha oversikt over situasjonen

  • kan følge rutiner og samtidig være fleksibel

  • har respekt for ham og ser gutten bak diagnosene

  • gjerne har erfaring med barn, autisme eller utviklingshemming, men personlig egnethet er svært viktig

  • har førerkort

  • gjerne har tilgang til egen bil

Vi ser fortrinnsvis etter en person i alderen 20–45 år, men det viktigste er at du er riktig person for jobben.

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ikke være perfekt eller ha alle svarene fra første dag. Det viktigste for oss er at du er en trygg voksen som møter ham med respekt, tålmodighet og godt humør.

Vi ønsker en person som kan bli en trygg og positiv del av hverdagen hans – en som både kan ta ansvar når det trengs og samtidig være med på å skape gode, morsomme og aktive opplevelser.

Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i dette og tror du kan passe godt sammen med vår gutt, håper vi å høre fra deg!


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Researcher in Environmental Psychology
employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR SAMFUNNS OG UTDANNINGSVITENSKAP
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You can find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the Job

We have a vacancy for a researcher at the Department of Psychology in the research group for Citizens, Environment and Safety for 2 years. 

The position combines work in three externally funded projects: 

(1)  The HARMONI project aims to develop a comprehensive knowledge toolbox for hybrid products that combine the benefits of cultivated and plant-based meat alternatives, enabling the creation of appealing new food concepts and expanding future food choices. To achieve this, HARMONI brings together a consortium of Cellular Agriculture and Bioprocess Engineering (Technical University of Munich), Meat Science, Cultivated Muscle Cells and Nutrition (Aarhus University), Material Science and Microbial Systems (Katholieke Universiteit Leuven), Sustainable Food Systems (University of Helsinki), and Environmental and Consumer Psychology (NTNU), complemented by leading industrial partners. The part of NTNU is to study consumer perceptions of such products with focus group interviews, experiments and surveys. Data is likely collected in Norway, Germany, Belgium, and Finnland.

(2)    The cells4energy project is a real-world laboratory for 100% renewable energy systems. At its core lies the systemic energy cell approach, where locally generated renewable energy is intelligently stored, utilized, and interconnected with other cells. Through digital technologies and innovative business models, we test in real-world environments how a flexible, resilient, and scalable energy supply can be achieved for the future. The task for NTNU in this project is to implement and analyse the results from an automatized internet-based intervention platform to motivate energy saving. Data will be collected in Austria. 

(3)    The SaferClay project is a research project focusing on developing methods to assess changes in quick clay landslide risk with time. SAFERCLAY will provide a new approach for adapted and sustainable risk management for living and building in quick clay areas, including recommendations to ensure both public and environmental safety. NTNUs task in this project is analysing perceptions of quick clay and its effects on behaviour in different stakeholder groups. A survey has been designed and is currently implemented in Norway. 

What binds the work in all three projects together is the focus on collecting citizen / stakeholder perceptions on novel products, risk factors, and behaviour interventions. In all three projects, these will primarily be studied with quantitative methods, thus excellent knowledge of quantitative analysis methods, data curation and handling, as well as designing research and surveys is essential. 

Your immediate leader is the head of department.


Duties of the position
  • Designing surveys, experiments and qualitative interviews with the respective project groups
  • Implementation of data collections (in cells4energy coordinated with an external technology provider for the internet platform)
  • Data cleaning and curation
  • Data analyses (mainly quantitative, but also qualitatitve)
  • Preparation of research papers based on the analyses
  • Feedback and coordination with the research partners
     

Required selection criteria
  • A finished degree or PhD in psychology with a specialization in environmental psychology, social psychology, behavioural psychology or closely related fields
  • Excellent skills in data management, curation and complex statistical analysis (e.g. structural equation modelling)
  • Experience in empirical work in the field
  • Good written and oral English skills

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with work in interdisciplinary fields
  • Experience with project management
  • Ability to communicate in at least one of the languages data in the different projects will be collected in (Norwegian, German, Finnish, Flemish, French) in addition to English
  • Experience with qualitative work

Personal characteristics
  • Flexibility
  • Ability to structure your work and handle three projects at the same time
  • Openness for collaboration with other disciplines and practice partners

We offer
  • exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • an open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues
  • favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • employee benefits

Salary and conditions

As a researcher (code 1109) you are normally paid from gross NOK 633 400 per annum before tax, depending on qualifications and seniority. As required by law, 2% of this salary will be deducted and paid into the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position is subject to external funding.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.   

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work. For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.  


About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English.

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English. 
Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.
If, for any reason, you have taken a career break or have had an atypical career and wish to disclose this in your application, the selection committee will take this into account, recognizing that the quantity of your research may be reduced as a result.

Your application must include:

  • CV, diplomas, and certificates
  • A motivation letter (max 2 pages) outlining your motivation and fit for the position
  • Academic works – published or unpublished – that you wish to be considered during assessment of your application (up to 5 items)
  • A description of the scientific/artistic works you consider most relevant, which you particularly wish to be factored into the assessment
  • A complete publication list
  • Details of projects for which you have served as project manager or had a significant position in, including information on financing, duration, and scope
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees

It is important that you both document and reflect on your competence. You are encouraged to use the NTNUs competence matrix as a guide for documentation of your competence.

Joint work will also be considered. If it is difficult to identify your specific input to a joint project, you must include evidence of your contributions. 

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential will also count in the assessment of the candidates. Open scientific practice will be recognized.

NTNU is obliged by the evaluation criteria for research quality in accordance with The San Fransisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and The obligations in the Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment ( CoARA) on responsible assessment of research and recognition of a wider range of academic contributions to science and society. This means that we will pay particular attention to the quality and academic range demonstrated by your scientific work to date. We will also pay attention to research leadership and participation in research projects. Your scientific work from the last five years will be given the most weight.

Your application will be considered by a committee at the department. Candidates of interest will be invited to an interview.


General information

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.   

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.  

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time. 

As an employee at NTNU, you must continually maintain and improve your professional development and be flexible regarding any organizational changes.

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you want to reserve yourself from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

For the sake of transparency, candidates will be given expert evaluations of their own and other candidates. As an applicant you are considered part of the process and are stipulated by rules of confidentiality. 

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Christian Klöckner, e-mail Christian.klockner@ntnu.no

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Ina Grønbech Halvorsen, e-mail Ina.G.Halvorsen@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 15.10.26

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Our research and teaching are based on five perspectives: biological, cognitive, social, personality and developmental psychology. Tilfredsstillende politiattest, ikke eldre enn tre måneder, må leveres før tiltredelse i stilling. Politiattest med merknader som innebærer yrkesforbud etter Helse- og omsorgstjenestelovens § 5-4a, vil medføre at tilbud om stilling bortfaller.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

title: Global Quality Systems Manager (m/f/d), (80-100%)
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

As a member of Accelleron’s Management Systems Team, you will be responsible for quality governance and certification in Switzerland, ensuring ongoing compliance and maintaining the company’s licence to operate.

You will support global and local quality teams through risk-based assessments, process improvements, and guidance, while coordinating cross-functional quality topics and driving them to sustainable resolution.

You will also contribute to key business projects with quality-related elements, taking the lead where appropriate.

The ideal candidate has a strong quality background, is proactive and self-motivated, and can effectively influence stakeholders without direct authority. The role offers a high level of autonomy and requires strong ownership and prioritization skills.
