Zakres obowiązków: Asystent rodziny prowadzi pracę z rodziną w miejscu jej zamieszkania lub w miejscu wskazanym przez rodzinę. Zadania asystenta rodziny realizowane są w pełnym wymiarze
czasu pracy w systemie zadaniowym.
Zakres wykonywanych zadań:
1) opracowywanie i realizacja planów pracy z rodzinami, we współpracy z członkami rodziny  i w konsultacji z pracownikiem socjalnym.
2) opracowywanie, we współpracy z członkami rodziny i koordynatorem rodzinnej pieczy
zastępczej, planu pracy z rodziną, który jest skoordynowany z planem pomocy dziecku umieszczonemu w pieczy zastępczej.
3) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w poprawie ich sytuacji życiowej, w tym w zdobywaniu,
umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego
4) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów socjalnych.
Więcej informacji na stronie internetowej:
http://paczkow.naszops.pl/pliki/plik/ogloszenie-asystent-rodziny-1790325922.pdf
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wykształcenie wyższe na kierunku pedagogika, psychologia, socjologia, nauki o rodzinie lub praca socjalna lub wykształcenie wyższe na dowolnym kierunku uzupełnione szkoleniem z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną i udokumentuje co najmniej roczny staż pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną lub średnie branżowe i szkolenie z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną, a także udokumentuje co najmniej 3-letni staż.
Sposób aplikowania:
- bezpośrednio do pracodawcy
- wymagane dokumenty: Druk kwestionariusza osobowego, klauzula informacyjna, oświadczenie dostępne są na stronie
internetowej Ośrodka Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie.
Dokumenty należy składać w sekretariacie Ośrodka do dnia 02.10.2026 r. do godziny 13.00 w
zamkniętej kopercie z dopiskiem: Dotyczy zatrudnienia osoby do wykonywania zadań
asystenta rodziny w Ośrodku Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie lub za pośrednictwem
poczty, kuriera (decyduje data wpływu do Ośrodka). Dokumenty, które wpłyną po upływie
wyżej określonego terminu lub będą niekompletne, nie będą rozpatrywane.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

Er du passioneret omkring digital markedsføring og har erfaring med at optimere online kampagner? Vi leder efter en dygtig og analytisk Digital Marketing Specialist til at blive en del af vores internationale team i Lissabon!

Dine ansvarsområder vil inkludere:

  • Implementere optimeringsløsninger og strategier for vores højværdi-kunder.

  • Annoncering på sociale medier, primært via Google Ads.

  • Udarbejdelse af keyword-pakker, budstrategier og budgetforslag.

  • Udvikle ekspertise i Googles produkter ved hjælp af optimeringsteknikker, herunder Google Search Network (GSN), Mobile og YouTube.

  • Analysere data og tendenser for at skabe meningsfulde indsigter og rapportere på centrale KPI’er.

Vi søger dig, som har:

  • Minimum 12 måneders erfaring med annonceringsoptimering (Google Ads foretrækkes, men erfaring med Meta Ads, Instagram Ads og LinkedIn Ads er også relevant).

  • En struktureret tilgang, stærke analytiske evner og lyst til at arbejde i et internationalt miljø.

  • Gode kommunikationsevner på engelsk (skriftligt og mundtligt).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Hybrid arbejdsmodel (2 dage om ugen på kontoret).

  • Kontor i det kreative og moderne LACS Anjos i Lissabon.

  • Relocation-pakke og støtte til at få NIF og NISS (for kandidater der flytter til Portugal).

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring, inkl. tandlæge- og familieplan.

  • Livsforsikring.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, fællesskab og innovation vægtes højt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Send din ansøgning og CV til LB@jobsqd.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: MECÂNICO E REPARADOR DE VEÍCULOS AUTOMÓVEIS

Procura-se um profissional com condução cuidada e preventiva, que zele pela preservação do camião e dos equipamentos transportados. Deverá possuir boas competências de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, nomeadamente capacidade para comunicar de forma clara e cordial com clientes, transmitir informações relevantes sobre entregas, recolhas e estado dos equipamentos, e colaborar eficazmente com a equipa operacional. Valorizam-se ainda pontualidade, autonomia, capacidade de resolução de problemas e uma postura profissional orientada para a qualidade do serviço e a satisfação do cliente.

São valorizadas competências pessoais como empatia, paciência, responsabilidade, sentido ético, boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e adaptação a diferentes contextos e públicos. A profissional deverá demonstrar compromisso com a melhoria contínua, atualização de conhecimentos e promoção do bem-estar, autonomia e inclusão dos utentes.

title: AGENTES DE CRÉDITO E EMPRÉSTIMOS
description:
E se o seu próximo trabalho fosse ajudar pessoas a concretizar alguns dos projetos mais importantes das suas vidas?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa de Intermediação de Crédito em Portimão e procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, de números e, sobretudo, de encontrar soluções.

Mais do que um Gestor de Crédito, procuramos uma pessoa curiosa, determinada e com vontade de fazer a diferença. Alguém capaz de ouvir um cliente, compreender a sua realidade e acompanhá-lo na procura de uma solução de financiamento adequada, competitiva e responsável.

No dia a dia, irá analisar necessidades e perfis financeiros, preparar e acompanhar processos de crédito, contactar entidades financeiras, comparar propostas e estar ao lado do cliente desde o primeiro contacto até à conclusão do processo.

Experiência na banca, crédito, seguros ou área financeira será valorizada, e muito. Mas não é o único caminho para chegar até nós. Se tem perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação, capacidade de organização e vontade genuína de aprender, queremos conhecê-lo(a).

Procuramos alguém com energia, empatia, responsabilidade, capacidade de negociação e gosto por objetivos. Acima de tudo, alguém que perceba que por detrás de cada processo existem pessoas, famílias e projetos de vida.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento, ferramentas de trabalho e uma equipa disponível para ajudar. Queremos que cresça profissionalmente, desenvolva competências e encontre espaço para construir o seu próprio percurso connosco.

Se procura apenas mais um trabalho, talvez não sejamos o projeto certo. Se procura uma oportunidade para aprender, crescer e sentir que o seu trabalho tem impacto real na vida das pessoas, queremos falar consigo.

title: AGENTE IMOBILIÁRIO E GESTOR DE PROPRIEDADES
description:
E se o seu próximo desafio profissional não tivesse dias todos iguais?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa imobiliária em Portimão e procuramos pessoas com energia, iniciativa e vontade de construir uma carreira onde o contacto humano, a autonomia e os resultados fazem parte do dia a dia.

Não procuramos apenas alguém para vender imóveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, que tenha curiosidade pelo mercado e que queira tornar-se um verdadeiro profissional de confiança para quem precisa de comprar ou vender uma casa.

O dia a dia passa por conhecer e trabalhar uma determinada zona, identificar oportunidades, contactar proprietários, angariar e promover imóveis, acompanhar compradores e vendedores, realizar visitas, negociar propostas e estar presente em todas as etapas até à concretização do negócio.

Já tem experiência no imobiliário ou na área comercial? Excelente. Nunca trabalhou no setor? Isso não é necessariamente um problema. Procuramos sobretudo atitude, capacidade de comunicação, resiliência e vontade de aprender. O conhecimento e as ferramentas podem ser adquiridos; a vontade de fazer acontecer tem de partir de si.

You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: ENFERMEIRO DE CUIDADOS GERAIS
description:
IPSS RECRUTA ENFERMEIRO/A, PARA AS SEGUINTES TAREFAS E FUNÇÕES:
- AVALIAR O ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E ACOMPANHAR A SUA EVOLUÇÃO,
- ADMINISTRAR MEDICAMENTOS E OUTROS TRATAMENTOS PRESCRITOS;
- EFETUAR TRATAMENTOS E CUIDADOS DE ENFERMAGEM, INCLUINDO PENSOS E CUIDADOS DE FERIDAS;
- MONITORIZAR SINAIS VITAIS, COMO TENSÃO ARTERIAL, TEMPERATURA, PULSO E GLICÉMIA;
- IDENTIFICAR ALTERAÇÕES NO ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E COMUNICAR AO MÉDICO OU À FAMÍLIA, QUANDO NECESSÁRIO;
- ACOMPANHAR RESIDENTES COM DOENÇAS CRÓNICAS E SITUAÇÕES DE DEPENDÊNCIA;
- PRESTAR CUIDADOS A RESIDENTES ACAMADOS OU COM MOBILIDADE REDUZIDA.

REQUISITOS:
- CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E RELACIONAMENTO INTERPESSOAL;
- SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE, ORGANIZAÇÃO E PROFISSIONALISMO;
- CAPACIDADE DE TRABALHO EM EQUIPA E DE ARTICULAÇÃO COM DIFERENTES PROFISSIONAIS DE SAÚDE;
- EMPATIA, RESPEITO E SENSIBILIDADE MO RELACIONAMENTOCOM PESSOAS IDOSAS E DEPENDENTES.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Garantir o bem-estar, a higiene, a alimentação e a segurança dos utentes, colaborando na manutenção e limpeza das instalações da instituição para assegurar um ambiente acolhedor e funcional. As Principais Funções serão os cuidados diretos ao utente, Prestar apoio na higiene pessoal, no vestir/despir, na alimentação e na mobilidade dos utentes.; Manutenção do espaço: Efetuar a limpeza e higienização dos quartos, salas comuns, casas de banho e outras áreas da instituição; Tratamento de roupas: Recolher, lavar, passar a ferro e organizar as roupas dos utentes e as roupas de cama/mesa da instituição; Apoio ao serviço de refeições: Ajudar na preparação, distribuição e recolha das refeições, bem como na lavagem da loiça e utensílios de cozinha; Vigilância e acompanhamento: Monitorizar o estado geral dos utentes, reportando imediatamente à equipa técnica (enfermeiros, assistentes sociais) qualquer alteração de comportamento ou de saúde.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Profissional responsável, empático e dinâmico, com gosto pelo apoio à pessoa idosa, capacidade de trabalho em equipa e experiência em cuidados de higiene, alimentação, mobilidade e conforto.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. •    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.

Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.

•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:

Handle complex customer requests through the ticketing system and live chat in Russian and English.

Prepare contracts and coordinate the signing process with customers and internal stakeholders.

Prepare and update instructions for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases.

Our expectations
At least four years of relevant experience in billing support, financial operations, accounts receivable, subscription services, or B2B customer support.
Proven experience independently handling complex billing enquiries, complaints, and escalations.
Good understanding of invoicing, payments, refunds, credit notes, account balances, and reconciliation processes.
Experience preparing, reviewing, or coordinating commercial contracts and related customer documentation.
Confident user of billing platforms, CRM systems, ticketing tools, and invoicing software.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filters, lookups, and pivot tables.
Strong numerical and analytical skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies across multiple systems.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with financial and contractual information.
Ability to prioritize a significant workload and take ownership of cases through to their complete resolution.
Experience coordinating issues with Finance, Sales, Legal, Account Management, and technical departments.

Strong business correspondence and customer-communication skills.
Fluency in written and spoken Russian.
English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher, sufficient for meetings, negotiations, and professional correspondence with international customers.
Ability to mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and contribute to process improvement.
Interest in technology and the ability to understand technically complex products and services.

Would be a plus
Experience in the hosting, cloud, telecommunications, SaaS, or other subscription-based industry.
Knowledge of recurring, usage-based, and multi-currency billing models.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti počítačových sietí
description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer to operate and develop our network infrastructure across multiple data centres.

Responsibilities
Configure, monitor, and maintain network equipment.
Troubleshoot network incidents and connectivity issues.
Perform planned maintenance and participate in emergency recovery.
Handle technical requests from customers and internal teams.
Support network expansion, new location deployments, and automation projects.
Maintain network documentation and configuration records.
Requirements
At least three years of relevant networking experience.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN, and WAN technologies.
Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and network redundancy.
Ability to diagnose routing, switching, latency, and packet-loss issues.
Experience configuring network equipment through CLI.
English at Intermediate level or higher.
Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.
Familiarity with Python, Ansible, APIs, or other automation tools.

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Dansk job i Málaga - Hvad hvis dit job var at få flere mennesker ud til koncerter, festivaler og oplevelser?
description:
Vi leder efter en dansk kollega til vores nordiske team i Málaga med opstart den senest den 1. november. Du bliver specialisten i en international virksomhed, hvor din opgave er at åbne døren til nye kunder i Danmark og booke møder til vores salgsteam.

Vi er en international tech- og eventvirksomhed i vækst, der hjælper arrangører med at sælge billetter og nå ud til nyt publikum. Hver dag går vores platform i gang med at sælge billetter til alt fra små uafhængige events til store festivaler. Og det er dig, der åbner døren til de arrangører, der får det til at ske.

Du kontakter eventarrangører i Danmark og booker de møder, som bliver til nye kunder og. Det er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du får din plads på vores nye, moderne kontor i det centrale Málaga, hvor du sidder side om side med kolleger fra marketing, salg, admin, HR og andre specialistfunktioner. Organisationen er flad, og vejene er korte.  Miljøet er det samme, som hvis du arbejdede på et kontor i Danmark: professionelt, uformelt og præget af høj faglighed.

Kontoret er nyt og moderne, med samme miljø som på et dansk kontor: gamingrum, massagerum, gratis frokost og et modent arbejdsmiljø, hvor tillid og ansvar er en selvfølge. Kort sagt: fast kontrakt, fair løn, sol udenfor og en hverdag med reel indflydelse på, at virksomheden vokser.

Det her er chancen for at kombinere en fast stilling og en fair løn med en hverdag i solen, i en virksomhed der er i vækst.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Opsøgende kontakt til eventarrangører i Danmark

  • Booking af møder til salgsteamet

  • Opbygning af gode dialoger og relationer med nye kontakter

  • Tæt sparring med salgsteamet for at sikre størst mulig værdi i møderne

Din hverdag:

Du arbejder med outbound og har mange samtaler med nye mennesker. Du planlægger selv din dag og dine rutiner og har ansvaret for at skabe resultater. Du sidder tæt på dine kolleger i salg og marketing og har direkte dialog med dem, der overtager de møder, du booker.

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

  • Du har minimum 1 års erfaring med outbound‑samtaler

  • Du er god til at skabe dialog og trives med kontakt til nye mennesker

  • Du er positiv, struktureret og vedholdende

  • Du er en stærk holdspiller

  • Du kan arbejde fast fra kontoret i Málaga

  • Du søger en stabil stilling – ikke et sabbatårsjob

Du behøver ikke mange års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og et højt drive.

Løn og benefits:

  • Fast kontrakt (Contrato Indefinido)

  • Løn: 2.500 EUR/md

  • Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

  • Arbejdstider:

    • Mandag–torsdag: 08.00–16.00

    • Fredag: 08.00–14.15

  • Frokostordning

  • Massageordning

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Udviklingsmuligheder i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Stærkt fællesskab med danske, svenske og norske kolleger

Om virksomheden

  • Internationalt eventfirma med kontor i det centrale Málaga

  • Mission: færre timer foran skærmen – flere koncerter, festivaler, foredrag og oplevelser

  • 50+ kolleger fra Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Spanien

  • Sælger millioner af billetter hvert år via egen platform

  • Moderne kontor med gamingrum, massagerum og et modent arbejdsmiljø

title: Account Manager Executive (German - speaking) -  Remote work in Spain - HE04 (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:

- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.

- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.

- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

description:
Envie de vivre à Barcelone tout en développant ta carrière dans la relation client ?

Alors cette opportunité est faite pour toi !

Chez Colybry, nous recrutons pour plusieurs entreprises partenaires basées à Barcelone. En postulant, ta candidature peut être présentée à plusieurs employeurs correspondant à ton profil, ce qui augmente tes chances de recrutement.

Au quotidien, tu accompagneras une clientèle francophone par téléphone, e-mail ou chat en :

Répondant aux demandes des clients ;

Écoutant et comprenant leurs besoins ;

Leur apportant des réponses claires et des solutions adaptées ;

Assurant le suivi des demandes jusqu'à leur résolution ;

Mettant à jour les informations dans l'outil CRM ;

Veillant à leur satisfaction et à la qualité du service.

Les missions précises pourront varier selon l'entreprise partenaire que tu rejoindras.

Le profil idéal

Pas besoin d'avoir déjà travaillé dans la relation client !

Nous recherchons avant tout des profils capables de :

faire preuve de motivation, de patience et de dynamisme ;

utiliser le téléphone et les outils numériques avec aisance ;

entretenir une bonne relation avec les clients et faire preuve de sens du service ;

écouter, analyser une demande et proposer une solution ;

apprendre et progresser ;

envisager une expérience professionnelle en Espagne.

Tu maîtrises le français à un niveau professionnel. Une formation complète est prévue dès ton arrivée pour te permettre de prendre rapidement tes marques.

À compétences égales, toutes les candidatures seront étudiées, notamment celles des personnes en situation de handicap.

Ce que tu vas adorer
Une vraie évolution de carrière

CDI à temps plein de droit espagnol ;

Formation lors de la prise de poste ;

Perspectives d'évolution interne ;

Environnement international et multiculturel.

Une qualité de vie exceptionnelle

Barcelone : plage, soleil et ambiance internationale ;

Une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle ;

Un environnement de travail convivial ;

Des avantages complémentaires selon l'entreprise partenaire.

Ton expatriation simplifiée

Colybry accompagne gratuitement les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement.

En cas de mobilité vers Barcelone, notre équipe peut également t'informer et t'accompagner dans tes démarches administratives et ta recherche de logement.

Prêt(e) à tenter l'aventure ?

Si tu souhaites vivre à Barcelone, travailler en français et développer de véritables compétences dans la relation client, n'attends plus : postule dès maintenant !
  
Motivation, patience et dynamisme, aisance au téléphone et avec les outils numériques, sens du service et bon relationnel. Français professionnel. Débutants acceptés, formation prévue.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

title: Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, sociale arrangementer og et kontor med havudsigt

  • Relocation-pakke (Betalt fly til Barcelona og den første måneds husleje betalt + økonomisk bolig støtte din anden måned)

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca – skiftschema
description:
Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca

Har du service i fokus, gillar att hjälpa andra och drömmer om en vardag i solen när hösten närmar sig?

Vår kundserviceavdelning fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu 5 nya kollegor med start i början av november 2026 till vårt kontor i Palma de Mallorca. Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i din karriär eller som vill upptäcka hur det är att bo och arbeta utomlands.

På Nordic Operation Center arbetar vi med både kundservice och telefonförsäljning för några av Nordens starkaste varumärken. Vi har en prestationsdriven arbetsmiljö med tydliga mål, tävlingar och en stark teamkultur.

Föreställ dig att kunna avsluta arbetsdagen med en promenad längs stranden, träna i solen eller äta middag i Palma tillsammans med dina nya kollegor. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera karriär med livsstil.

Urval och anställning sker löpande, så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan – kanske är det just dig vi söker!

Om rollen

Som kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med inkommande kundärenden via telefon. Du hjälper kunder på ett professionellt och effektivt sätt, där kvalitet och ett gott bemötande alltid står i fokus.

Arbetstiderna kan variera mellan dag, kväll och natt, beroende på vilket projekt du tilldelas.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    Hantera bokningar och avbokningar

    Hjälpa både privat- och företagskunder

    Arbeta mot tydliga mål kopplade till kundnöjdhet och effektivitet

Du blir en viktig del av teamet, där din insats direkt påverkar både kundupplevelsen och resultatet.

Vi erbjuder

    Heltidstjänst med stegrande lön

    20 dagars betald semester per år

    Betald introduktion och utbildning

    Möjlighet att utvecklas och göra karriär inom bolaget

    En arbetsplats med stark gemenskap och högt engagemang

    Möjlighet att bo och arbeta i Spanien

    Hjälp med spanska dokument, såsom NIE och socialförsäkring

    Bostadshjälp genom kontaktuppgifter till både mäklare och hyresvärdar

Vi söker dig som

    Är noggrann, strukturerad och stresstålig

    Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo

    Är bekväm med telefon och dator som arbetsverktyg

    Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift samt har grundläggande engelska

    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov

Är du rätt person för jobbet?

Tjänsten passar dig som är redo att göra något nytt, hitta en ny vardag eller utvecklas snabbt inom kundservice. Du är positiv, målinriktad och arbetar effektivt mot uppsatta mål med hög kvalitet.

Den viktigaste pelaren på Nordic Operation Center är vår kultur. Vår vision är att bygga ett andra hem för vårt team, där vi alltid sätter våra medarbetare i fokus.

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men inget krav. Är du vårt nästa stjärnskott – eller har du det som krävs för att bli det?

Vi söker nya stjärnor, men vi är också med och skapar dem från grunden!

title: Dansk job i Málaga - Hvad hvis dit job var at få flere mennesker ud til koncerter, festivaler og oplevelser?
description:
Vi leder efter en dansk kollega til vores nordiske team i Málaga med opstart den senest den 1. november. Du bliver specialisten i en international virksomhed, hvor din opgave er at åbne døren til nye kunder i Danmark og booke møder til vores salgsteam.

Vi er en international tech- og eventvirksomhed i vækst, der hjælper arrangører med at sælge billetter og nå ud til nyt publikum. Hver dag går vores platform i gang med at sælge billetter til alt fra små uafhængige events til store festivaler. Og det er dig, der åbner døren til de arrangører, der får det til at ske.

Du kontakter eventarrangører i Danmark og booker de møder, som bliver til nye kunder og. Det er ikke et callcenterjob med manuskript. Du får din plads på vores nye, moderne kontor i det centrale Málaga, hvor du sidder side om side med kolleger fra marketing, salg, admin, HR og andre specialistfunktioner. Organisationen er flad, og vejene er korte.  Miljøet er det samme, som hvis du arbejdede på et kontor i Danmark: professionelt, uformelt og præget af høj faglighed.

Kontoret er nyt og moderne, med samme miljø som på et dansk kontor: gamingrum, massagerum, gratis frokost og et modent arbejdsmiljø, hvor tillid og ansvar er en selvfølge. Kort sagt: fast kontrakt, fair løn, sol udenfor og en hverdag med reel indflydelse på, at virksomheden vokser.

Det her er chancen for at kombinere en fast stilling og en fair løn med en hverdag i solen, i en virksomhed der er i vækst.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Opsøgende kontakt til eventarrangører i Danmark

  • Booking af møder til salgsteamet

  • Opbygning af gode dialoger og relationer med nye kontakter

  • Tæt sparring med salgsteamet for at sikre størst mulig værdi i møderne

Din hverdag:

Du arbejder med outbound og har mange samtaler med nye mennesker. Du planlægger selv din dag og dine rutiner og har ansvaret for at skabe resultater. Du sidder tæt på dine kolleger i salg og marketing og har direkte dialog med dem, der overtager de møder, du booker.

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

  • Du har minimum 1 års erfaring med outbound‑samtaler

  • Du er god til at skabe dialog og trives med kontakt til nye mennesker

  • Du er positiv, struktureret og vedholdende

  • Du er en stærk holdspiller

  • Du kan arbejde fast fra kontoret i Málaga

  • Du søger en stabil stilling – ikke et sabbatårsjob

Du behøver ikke mange års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og et højt drive.

Løn og benefits:

  • Fast kontrakt (Contrato Indefinido)

  • Løn: 2.500 EUR/md

  • Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

  • Arbejdstider:

    • Mandag–torsdag: 08.00–16.00

    • Fredag: 08.00–14.15

  • Frokostordning

  • Massageordning

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Udviklingsmuligheder i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Stærkt fællesskab med danske, svenske og norske kolleger

Om virksomheden

  • Internationalt eventfirma med kontor i det centrale Málaga

  • Mission: færre timer foran skærmen – flere koncerter, festivaler, foredrag og oplevelser

  • 50+ kolleger fra Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Spanien
