title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer - Finance
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

_______________________________________________________________________________

To strengthen our capabilities in analytics engineering and data visualisation, Etraveli Group is now recruiting a Senior Business Intelligence Developer with a focus on Finance to join the BI team.

The role can be located in either Uppsala or Stockholm.

About the job

You will be joining our BI team in creating and maintaining data pipelines and relevant business intelligence applications. The latter are presently created in Qlik Sense and Looker. Work is also underway to evolve our tech stack by implementing dbt and a new data platform. You will play a vital role in this journey, taking a major part in shaping how our BI team evolves its ways of working.

Your role will require both a deep understanding of the business needs and the skill set to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. You will have a close direct connection and collaboration with other groups and departments acting as stakeholders for the applications you develop.

Our BI team is split across the offices in Uppsala, Stockholm, Göteborg, Mumbai and Athens, and caters to the whole organisation. In total we are nineteen developers and our processes and technical setup are mature, but constantly adapting to the business and the technical landscape.

The data you will be using is mostly structured in databases maintained by the IT-department and we use several different database technologies. Less structured data will also occur frequently.

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a company with grand plans and great expectations. You will have awesome colleagues together with whom you will solve complex problems in a fast-moving business.

To summarise the job will include:

    development of business intelligence applications, focusing primarily on financial reporting and analytics
    

    analytics engineering, data modelling, and building robust data pipelines
    

    taking a senior role and contribute to define how the BI-team should adopt work in the new data platform
    

    working closely and directly with stakeholders, especially within the Finance department

Requirements

You need to be passionate about business and numbers since the job requires both a deep understanding of the business needs, as well as the ability to acquire, handle and analyse the relevant data. Personality-wise you are curious, methodical, ambitious and thorough. More formally, you have:

    a university degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, engineering or similar)
    

    either or both: extensive professional experience of development in some Business Intelligence tools (e.g., QlikView, Qlik Sense, Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and/or experience with analytics engineering, writing pipelines for analytical data in a data warehouse technology. Experience with dbt, Dremio and/or spark in particular are seen as big advantages
    

    demonstrated abilities in handling data with code and to produce meaningful data visualizations that can drive insights
    

    strong communication skills including excellent command of spoken and written English

Experience working with financial data, financial reporting concepts, or ERP systems is highly beneficial, as you will be working closely with our Finance department.

Benefits

Working at Etraveli Group means working at a fast-growing company with high ambitions in becoming the number one Online travel agency worldwide. The culture at the company embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company.

We offer:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid model where you can choose to work two days from home and two weeks per year from a remote location.
    

    Central office locations – We are located on Regeringsgatan in Stockholm and Dragarbrunnsgatan in Uppsala, a stone's throw from public transport and lunch restaurants.
    

    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    

    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

Welcome to Etraveli Group!

description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Etraveli Group has ~3,000 employees and uses market-leading agentic tools and production autonomous agents to drive productivity across all functions, including bespoke use cases.

This role owns rollout, standards, training, and support for our agentic toolkit, alongside leading the Tech/Legal cross-functional governance forum.

title: Hotellchef till Skara Konsthotell
description:
Hotellchef till Skara Konsthotell

Vill du leda en verksamhet där hotell, mat och konst möts? Vi söker en engagerad hotellchef som vill utveckla Skara Konsthotell tillsammans med våra medarbetare och skapa upplevelser som får gästerna att återvända.

Skara Konsthotell är en del av Jula Hotell och ingår i Julakoncernen, där utveckling och nyfikenhet driver oss framåt. Hos oss arbetar vi tillsammans och är där gästen är.

Med 98 hotellrum, konferenslokaler, restaurang och konsthall erbjuder vi en unik miljö för både privatgäster och affärsresenärer. I restaurangen står lokala råvaror i centrum. I konsthallen möter gästerna verk av några av Sveriges främsta konstnärer, bland andra Anders Zorn och Carl Larsson, samt tillfälliga utställningar med lokala konstnärer.

Din roll som hotellchef

Som hotellchef har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetens drift, personal, kvalitet och lönsamhet. Du arbetar både operativt och strategiskt, med fokus på att utveckla affären, skapa en god arbetsmiljö och ge våra gäster en upplevelse av hög kvalitet.

Du är närvarande i verksamheten och leder genom dina underställda chefer. Genom tydliga mål, stöd och uppföljning ger du dem förutsättningar att utveckla sina team och verksamheten. Tillsammans skapar ni arbetssätt som stärker både service och resultat.

Du leder hotellets ledningsgrupp, rapporterar till VD och ingår i Jula Hotells centrala ledningsgrupp.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

    Leda och utveckla verksamheten genom ett nära och engagerat ledarskap.
    Driva försäljning och affärsutveckling samt följa upp resultat.
    Ta fram budget och prognoser samt löpande följa upp ekonomi och drift tillsammans med VD.
    Förhandla lokala avtal och följa upp inköp och kostnader.
    Planera evenemang tillsammans med ditt team.
    Ta fram hotellets marknadsplan tillsammans med vår centrala försäljningsavdelning.
    Säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö och en bemanning som möter verksamhetens behov.

Din bakgrund och erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som har ledarerfarenhet och en god förståelse för hur ekonomi, bemanning och kvalitet påverkar verksamhetens resultat. Du är trygg med att använda rapporter och ekonomiska analyser som underlag för beslut och förbättringar.

För rollen behöver du ha:

    Erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare.
    Ekonomisk utbildning eller lång erfarenhet av att arbeta med ekonomiska rapporter och förstå ekonomiska analyser.
    Vana att ta fram budget och prognoser.
    Erfarenhet av inköp och av att arbeta i system för leverantörsfakturor.
    Vana att arbeta i schemaläggningsprogram.

Det är meriterande om du även har:

    Erfarenhet från hotell- och restaurangbranschen.
    Erfarenhet av att leda andra chefer och ledare.
    Erfarenhet av försäljning och revenue management.
    Erfarenhet från campingbranschen.

Du som person

Du är en öppen, varm och social ledare som skapar förtroende och samarbete. Du lyssnar, engagerar och ger andra utrymme att växa, samtidigt som du är tydlig med förväntningar och fattar beslut även när de är svåra.

Du trivs i en verksamhet där tempot varierar och flera frågor behöver hanteras samtidigt. Med struktur och noggrannhet prioriterar du det som är viktigast, delegerar när det behövs och agerar snabbt när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du har ett gott ekonomiskt sinne och ser möjligheter att utveckla både affären och gästupplevelsen. Din nyfikenhet, servicekänsla och förmåga att omsätta idéer i handling hjälper dig att driva verksamheten framåt tillsammans med ditt team.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Bra att veta

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Jula Hotell har kollektivavtal med Unionen.

Så här söker du

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-31. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdagen, så skicka gärna din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta VD Patrik Turnesjö på mailto:patrik.turnesjo@julahotell.se

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Senior UI Designer
description:
Would you like to shape how players experience a game, from the first interaction to the details that make each feature easy and enjoyable to use?

As a Senior UI Designer at Snowprint, you’ll design and implement UI for our games, working closely with designers, developers, artists, and other disciplines to turn ideas into experiences that players can use and enjoy. You’ll have ownership of your work, from early concepts and wireframes through to testing and improvement.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and contribute beyond their own discipline. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how we approach UI, establish good practices, and help create experiences that put the player first.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll design UI for new features and game systems, creating wireframes, mockups, and interaction patterns that make complex functionality clear and easy to use. You’ll bring your designs into Unity using UI Toolkit, working hands-on to turn them into polished, functional experiences.

You’ll playtest and evaluate your work regularly, gathering feedback and using it to improve the player experience. You’ll work closely with game designers, client developers, artists, and other team members throughout planning, development, and testing.

You’ll also contribute to how we work with UI as a discipline. This includes establishing best practices, creating useful workflows, and helping maintain consistency across the game. You’ll have room to influence the direction of the UI while balancing design principles with the practical realities of production.

Is this you?

You’re an experienced UI Designer with professional experience designing for games, including mobile and touch interfaces. You have worked on at least one game in a free-to-play, midcore, turn-based strategy, live-operated, or external IP environment, with experience across several of these areas being particularly relevant.

You have experience implementing UI in Unity, and if you have experience with UI Toolkit that would be great. You’re comfortable working with tools such as Figma, the Google Suite, and Adobe Suite, and have experience with version control such as GitHub.

You care about practical UI/UX design and getting your work into the hands of players. You understand common patterns and best practices in mobile games, but also know when consistency needs to give way to a better solution for the player or the product.

You pay attention to detail and understand that not every problem needs a perfect solution. You’re comfortable giving and receiving feedback, asking questions, and discussing your ideas openly. You take ownership of your work and enjoy working with others to find solutions that balance design, technical constraints, and production needs.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment — while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Control System Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Control Systems Engineer to lead and support the development and sustaining of SIMATIC SPPA-T3000 and PCS 7 control system for our medium gas turbines. As a part of our team, you will develop and maintain control system software applications for our medium gas turbines to ensure our products meet the requirements set in the market. The position requires close collaboration and working alongside other departments and designers to integrate control system into the overall design of MGT products.

How You Will Make an Impact

    Be a part of a highly skilled development team responsible for the development and maintenance of control system software applications for the MGT products.
    Be responsible for the engineering work and technical solutions in the assigned development projects, working closely with the project team and project manager to ensure that the design meets specified requirements aligned with the technical road map.
    Design and configure T3000 and PCS 7 control systems, including control logic, hardware setup, server and computer networks, safety systems, trip chains, and HMI/OS displays, while adhering to configuration management, version control, and rigorous testing to ensure system integrity.
    Integrate field instrumentation and subsystems; manage communications via common industrial protocols (e.g., ProfNet, Profibus, Modbus TCP, and OPC).
    Apply industry standards and best practices for safety, quality, and cybersecurity.
    Consistently acquire new skills and knowledge while sharing them by mentoring and assisting others over time. Contribute to enhancing our processes and methods to improve team performance and project outcomes within the team’s responsibilities.

What You Will Bring

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in control engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience working with automation and control technologies, with an interest in new technologies and the use of existing technologies in new contexts.
    Proficient English skills, allowing you to express yourself fluently and communicate effectively at a professional level.
    Excellent interpersonal skills combined with experience working with colleagues and customers in international settings.

Experience in the following areas is advantageous:

    SPPA-T3000 and/or PCS 7
    Modeling and simulation in MATLAB or a related tool
    Functional Safety (SIL)
    Cybersecurity
    System networking and VMware

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Hemstädare / Home cleaner - Kungsbacka(Onsala, Fjärås, Frillesås, Åsa)
description:
Hemstädare till Hemfrid – Kungsbacka med omnejd (Onsala, Fjärås, Frillesås, Åsa).

Gillar du ordning och reda, möten med människor och att ge bra service? Tycker du att ett välstädat hem gör stor skillnad i vardagen? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig.

Hemfrid söker nu hemstädare till Kungsbacka och närliggande kommuner. Hos oss arbetar du nära våra kunder och hjälper dem till en enklare och tryggare vardag – med kvalitet, service och ett vänligt bemötande.

Moppning och rengöring av ytor

    

Tvätt, strykning och vikning av kläder

Vi söker dig som:

    

Har god servicekänsla och tycker om att hjälpa andra

    

Är noggrann, punktlig och ansvarstagande

    

Trivs med att arbeta självständigt

    

Har erfarenhet från serviceyrke (hemstädning är meriterande, men inget krav)

    

Talar och förstår grundläggande svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta vardagar mellan kl. 08.00–17.00

    

Har B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil

Anställning

    

Tillsvidareanställning

    

Sysselsättningsgrad: 75–90 %

    

Fast månadslön

    

Kollektivavtal

Trygga anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring

    

Friskvårdsbidrag

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang

    

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom Hemfrid

    

Ett team med kollegor från hela världen och god stämning

Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör inom hushållsnära tjänster. Vi hjälper människor i deras vardag genom städning, tvätt, flytt och trädgårdsarbete – alltid med fokus på kvalitet och service.

Rekryteringsprocess

Efter inskickad ansökan kontaktar HR dig. Bakgrundskontroll ingår i rekryteringsprocessen. För tjänsten krävs svenskt personnummer eller samordningsnummer.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Home Cleaner at Hemfrid – Kungsbacka and Surrounding Areas  (Onsala, Fjärås, Frillesås, Åsa).

Do you enjoy order, meeting people, and providing great service? Do you believe a clean home can make a big difference in someone’s day? Then this could be the job for you.

Hemfrid is now looking for home cleaners in Kungsbacka and nearby areas. With us, you work closely with customers and help make their everyday life easier and more comfortable – with quality, service, and a friendly approach.

About the role

As a home cleaner at Hemfrid, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes. You work independently, plan your tasks, and make sure each customer feels satisfied and well taken care of. It’s not just cleaning – it’s service with care.

Tasks

Your work may include:

    

Vacuuming and dusting

    

Mopping and cleaning surfaces

    

Laundry, ironing, and folding clothes

    

Making beds and changing sheets

    

Adding that little extra touch that makes a big difference

About you

We are looking for someone who:

    

Has a strong sense of service and enjoys helping others

    

Is precise, responsible, and punctual

    

Can work independently

    

Has experience in a service role (home cleaning experience is a plus but not required)

    

Speaks and understands basic Swedish or English

    

Can work weekdays between 08:00–17:00

Employment

    

Permanent position

    

75–90 % employment

    

Fixed monthly salary

    

Collective agreement

We offer

    

Introduction and training in home cleaning – we’ll show you how we work

    

Secure employment conditions

    

Liability, health, and pension insurance

    

Wellness allowance

    

Free mobile subscription

    

Opportunities to grow within Hemfrid

    

A team with colleagues from all over the world and a friendly work environment

About Hemfrid

Hemfrid is Sweden’s leading provider of household services. We help people with cleaning, laundry, moving, and gardening – always focusing on quality and excellent service.

Recruitment process

After submitting your application, our HR team will contact you. Background checks are part of the recruitment process. A Swedish personal identity number or coordination number is required.

We look forward to receiving your application – we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Supply Chain Process Specialist
description:
At Beiersdorf, home of Nivea, Eucerin, Hansaplast & Labello we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.



We are looking for a proactive, business-focused Process Specialist to lead the development and optimisation of customer management and Supply Chain processes across the Nordics.



Acting as the Nordic SAP customer management SME, you will drive best practices, translate business requirements into effective system solutions, and collaborate with global SAP key users and IT teams to deliver continuous improvement.



As part of our digital transformation journey, you will leverage technologies such as AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation tools to improve efficiency, simplify processes, and develop innovative solutions that enhance employee and customer experiences.



To stay connected to customer needs, you will periodically support customer order management activities, using these insights to identify process improvements and strengthen the overall customer experience.



This is a Fixed Term Contract up to 15 months



Your Tasks

    Lead the implementation of global customer management projects and digital transformation initiatives within the Nordic region, working in close collaboration with the Global SAP key user community
    Act as the primary point of contact for SAP-related matters within the Nordic Supply Chain organization, including the creation and management of IT support tickets as needed.
    Drive the adoption and effective use of AI-powered tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve productivity and process efficiency.
    Identifying recurring process failures and working on sustainable corrective actions
    Identify opportunities for automation and lead initiatives that eliminate manual activities and simplify workflows.
    Design, develop, or coordinate the implementation of automation solutions and bots that improve operational performance and service quality.
    Maintain strong process governance by ensuring key processes are documented, updated, and followed.
    Coordinate EDI-related projects in collaboration with internal IT functions and customers' IT departments
    Support customer order management activities when needed to maintain operational insight and identify opportunities for improvement



Your Profile

    Strong experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems; EDI understanding is a plus.
    Strong understanding of customer management, order-to-cash and supply chain processes.
    Experience driving process improvements, system enhancements, or business transformation initiatives.
    Experience working with AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, or similar technologies
    Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data and insights into practical actions and improvements.
    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate and simplify messages across functions and organizational levels
    A continuous improvement mindset and a passion for process excellence and customer experience.



Please submit your CV in English



At Beiersdorf, we see you as a person – far beyond your title or role. Our goal is to provide the flexibility and support you need for your professional and personal success through our work environment. That is why we have a lot to offer!



    Competitive salary
    Bonus
    Private Health Insurance
    Pension
    30 days vacation per year
    Wellness fee
    Meal vouchers
    Discounted product purchases
    Leave entitlements and wellbeing support to include access to an excellent Employee Assistance Programme



At Beiersdorf, we believe that every individual brings unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths that deserve to be valued and celebrated. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels empowered to be themselves, thrive in their role, and work in ways that enable them to succeed. Through flexibility, understanding, accessibility, and meaningful support, we aim to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, heard, and able to reach their full potential.



We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process to support you.

title: Fixed Asset Register (FAR) Accountant to industrial company!
description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional with a strong understanding of engineering and project controls? Do you excel at bridging the gap between physical assets and financial records in large-scale projects? Then this might be something for you!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Fixed Asset Register (FAR) Accountant on behalf of our client, a pioneering industrial enterprise driving large-scale green energy and manufacturing initiatives. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring that major project expenditures are correctly identified, classified, and recorded as assets in accordance with regulatory and accounting standards. You will act as the vital link between Project Controls, Finance, and Engineering. The position is based in either Stockholm or Boden, with the possibility of working remotely at ca 50%.

Your daily tasks

As a FAR Accountant, you will treat the Fixed Asset Register as a controlled financial record, ensuring every material asset and associated cost is traceable and audit-ready. Your main tasks will include:

    Maintain and regularly reconcile the FAR against project cost records, commitments, invoices, and approved asset structures
    Collaborate closely with Engineering to identify, describe, and allocate equipment, systems, tag numbers, asset hierarchy, and commissioning status
    Track assets through procurement, construction, installation, commissioning, and handover to reflect real-time physical status
    Identify operational assets and coordinate with Finance for timely capitalisation and commencement of depreciation
    Ensure proper cost allocation across equipment, installation, engineering, and directly attributable costs
    Identify and resolve discrepancies between the FAR, cost systems, procurement records, and engineering data
    Maintain a robust audit trail for asset values, classifications, adjustments, and capitalisation decisions
    Support periodic physical verification of assets with Engineering and Operations
    Produce regular FAR completeness and reconciliation reports, escalating any gaps that could compromise compliance

Your characteristics

We are looking for someone who takes full ownership of financial controls and approaches asset tracking with precision and analytical rigor. You are a collaborative communicator who seamlessly bridges technical engineering insights with strict accounting compliance. You understand that the FAR is not just an administrative schedule, but a critical, controlled financial record.

Is this the challenge you are looking for? We welcome your application today! In this recruitment process, we only accept applications written in English.

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or equivalent relevant background
    Proven experience in fixed asset control, capital expenditure (CapEx) accounting, or project controls within large-scale industrial/engineering projects
    Strong proficiency in financial ERP systems, project cost controls software, and Excel.
    Fluent in spoken and written English

Meritorious:

    Experience working in complex industrial, energy, or manufacturing construction environments
    Deep familiarity with regulatory accounting policies and internal/external audit standards regarding fixed assets

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-01-31. Start 2026-10-13.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36026 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

title: Experienced Solution Architect - Cloud, Solna
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of cloud-based API solutions? Join PostNord in Stockholm as an experienced Solution Architect and help build digital services that make a real difference.

At PostNord, technology and social responsibility come together to create digital solutions used by millions of people every day. As an experienced Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our digital future. We offer a collaborative, forward-looking environment where innovation is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work has a meaningful impact.

What We Offer You

    A strategic role with the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions and the design of future-ready system support.

    Work with clear social relevance, contributing to logistics solutions that support people, businesses, and society.

    A value-driven workplace that prioritizes wellbeing, flexibility, and sustainable work-life balance.

    Strong opportunities for professional development, including sponsorship for cloud certifications.

    A hybrid way of working, with access to a newly renovated office in Solna.

What You Will Do With Us

You will join Sender Solutions within Customer Solutions at PostNord Group IT. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Booking API team and other teams across Sender Solutions to define architecture that meets today’s business needs while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities. Our solutions must meet high expectations for reliability, scalability, and efficiency, supporting both our customers and our long-term technology strategy.

Your role in brief

    Shape the design and architecture of digital shipping solutions in close collaboration with the tech lead, product owner, and colleagues in the team.

    Spend part of your time contributing hands-on as a system developer in the Booking API team, maintaining deep solution knowledge and staying closely connected to the team’s day-to-day work.

    Contribute to the development and maintenance of large-scale solutions and integrations with complex dependencies.

    Represent Sender Solutions in cross-area architecture forums, working closely with tech leads across the area.

    Support product owners and teams in dialogue with major customers.

    Drive innovation and continuous improvement to deliver solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

You will join a skilled team of around ten developers working across both back-end and front-end development. You will work closely with the team’s product owner, and your immediate manager will be Annika Dahlström. The team uses technologies such as:

    AWS Microservices / Serverless.

    NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript / Java

    DynamoDB, Postgres, SQS, IAM, OAuth2, Fargate, S3, Elasticsearch, to name a few.

    Swagger, Grafana, GitHub, XML/JSON, CI/CD

We are an engaged and ambitious team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Most of the team works from our office in Solna, with additional developers based in the Philippines. We apply a hybrid working model, with at least 60% of working time spent at the office. For this role, we would welcome a Solution Architect who can be on site more frequently to support close collaboration. We also offer flexible working hours.

More About You

You are an experienced architect with solid expertise in cloud technologies, system development, and API development. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and thrive in a role where you guide, inspire, and support your team. You have an academic degree in IT, or equivalent practical experience, and communicate fluently in both Swedish and English. Experience from the logistics industry is an advantage, as is an understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, can be applied to create business value. Above all, you are collaborative, strategic, and customer-focused. You communicate clearly and adapt your message to different audiences and levels of technical understanding.

About us

We move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

Welcome to submit your application. The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, certain positions may require a background check. If you progress to a stage where a background check is necessary, you will be informed in advance.

If you have any questions or concerns, please email emina.delkic@postnord.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Read more about our union representatives

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

title: Hemstädare / Home cleaner - Hemfrid Gävle

Your profile We enjoy making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. You like working independently, are driven by quality and customer service, and have a positive, responsible attitude with an eye for details.

En tillsvidareanställning med 50- 75 % sysselsättningsgrad.

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.

Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

title: Open application - Data Center Technician to a World Leading Tech Company
description:
This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.

When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.

Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

On behalf of one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies, we are looking for two skilled Data Center Technician to their Data Center in Gävle Sweden. If you are looking for a unique career opportunity, that will provide you with many chances to learn, grow and further develop your skills within IT, Support, Hardware, Servers and more than this could be the right role for you.

You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. The team you will be joining covers the below responsibilities:

    Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific instructions, checklists, guides, standard protocols, and emails.
    Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
    Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components.
    Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.

Requirements:

    Basic knowledge of computer hardware, servers, and components.
    1+ year(s) experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
    Basic understanding of how to use Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word).
    High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
    CompTIA / CCNA/ CDCP would be highly beneficial.
    To be considered for this role, you must hold a Swedish passport or permanent residency (PR).

We can offer you:

    Attractive working conditions
    Employment at one of the world’s most recognizes companies who over and over is celebrated as one of the world’s greatest places to work.
    Work schedule is full time.

Preferred start date: Depending on the request

End date: 6 months and very high possibility for longer and also to get a full time position at the client after a year.

Location: Gävle, Sweden

Application

You will be employed by Temp-Team Sweden, but working full-time at our client’s location. Our client wishes for the right candidate to be hired asap, thus we are reviewing applications and inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis. If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, send us a targeted CV in English as soon as possible.

It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your resume.

For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se or Kristina Gelevska at kga@temp-team.se

Hybrid work from our office at Lindholmen

title: Site Engineering and Reliability Lead
description:

Responsibilities:                    

    Responsible for the site engineering and equipment reliability strategy.
    Responsible for site engineering project portfolio & asset stewardship consolidation in partnership with site Leadership.
    Responsible to commission and qualify all new and existing upgraded equipment at site inline with Kenvue’s C&Q policy.
    Direct, guide and provide oversight for the site CapEx portfolio including forecasting, prioritizing budgeting, controlling and reporting of the site capital plan, communicating status and health to site and network stakeholders.
    Responsible for delivering equipment, capital and automation upgrades and innovation at site through working with regional and global team.
    Responsible for Standard deployment of capital programs in line with health authority requirements meeting Kenvue compliance and quality standards.
    Coordinate and develop of Site Master Plan (3-5 years).

    Responsible for 5-7 direct reports and their performance and developments.



Qualifications

title: Customer Service Representative

title: Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations
employer: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
description:
Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations

OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure

HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Technical Package Manager – Special Foundations to join the OL31 project in Vagnhärad. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a major infrastructure development, where you will be responsible for driving coordination, fostering collaboration across multiple stakeholders, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution.

About the Role

As Technical Package Manager - Special Foundations, you will take technical ownership of all special foundation works within the project. The role requires a highly experienced specialist with extensive knowledge of both the design and construction of special foundation systems.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging engineering designs produced by external designers and consultants, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically sound, buildable, compliant, and suitable for construction. You will act as the key technical authority for foundation-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

·        Lead the technical management of the Special Foundations package throughout the project lifecycle.

·        Review, verify and challenge foundation designs prepared by engineering consultants and designers.

·        Perform detailed design reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable standards and best engineering practices.

·        Evaluate the constructability, feasibility and technical suitability of proposed foundation solutions.

·        Assess geotechnical reports, design calculations, technical specifications and construction methodologies.

·        Ensure compliance with Swedish regulations, Eurocodes and project-specific requirements.

·        Provide technical guidance to project management, procurement teams and construction personnel.

·        Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies.

·        Support procurement activities, tender evaluations and technical clarifications related to foundation works.

·        Coordinate with designers, contractors, geotechnical specialists and other project stakeholders.

·        Monitor site execution and ensure that construction works are carried out in accordance with approved designs and quality standards.

·        Manage technical interfaces between foundation works and other project disciplines.



Your Profile

Required Qualifications & Experience

·        Degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering or a related field.

·        Minimum 7 years of experience in a senior technical role involving special foundations, geotechnical engineering or heavy civil construction.

·        Proven experience in both the design and execution of special foundation works.

·        Demonstrated ability to independently review and validate engineering designs prepared by third parties.

·        Strong understanding of geotechnical design principles, structural behavior and construction methodologies.

·        Experience with foundation systems such as: Piling works, Deep foundations, Ground improvement solutions, Retaining structures, Earth retention systems and Ground stabilization techniques, etc.

·        Experience on large industrial, infrastructure or complex construction projects.

·        Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

·        Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Language Requirements

    Professional working proficiency in English is required.
    Swedish is highly meritorious due to the project's regulatory environment, documentation requirements.

We Offer

    The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
    An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
    Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
    The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.



Location

Vagnhärad, Sweden



Apply

If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.



Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,

or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/



Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

title: Head of Medium Gas Turbine Controls in Engineering
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day collaborating with engineering leaders, project teams and regional stakeholders to align priorities, resources and customer needs. Throughout the day, you guide strategic initiatives, support project execution, review organizational capabilities and drive continuous improvement activities. You work closely with product management, project execution and regional organizations to strengthen collaboration, develop talent and ensure high-quality controls solutions. By balancing people leadership, operational excellence and business objectives, you help position the Medium Gas Turbine Controls organization for sustainable growth and long-term success.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Strategic leadership and development of the global Medium Gas Turbine Controls engineering organization, fostering collaboration, accountability, continuous learning and high performance
    Alignment of organizational capabilities, competencies and workforce planning with business growth objectives, future market demands and long-term strategy
    Implementation of the Medium Gas Turbine Controls Service growth plan in close collaboration with regional organizations
    Delivery of high-quality, efficient and reliable engineering execution with a strong focus on customer value, project performance and business results
    Harmonization and continuous improvement of engineering processes, methodologies, standards and digital solutions to increase efficiency, quality and scalability
    Strengthening of cross-functional collaboration, talent development, succession planning and operational excellence across engineering, project execution, product management and regional teams

What You Bring

    Engineering degree or comparable technical background with experience in controls, automation, electrical engineering or related disciplines
    Solid professional experience in Medium Gas Turbines and/or turbine control systems
    Proven leadership experience with a strong commitment to developing people, building high-performing teams and creating an inclusive work environment
    Strong customer orientation and ability to translate business requirements into sustainable and effective engineering solutions
    Strategic mindset, curiosity and passion for innovation, continuous improvement, digitalization and positive organizational change
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment, fluent English language skills, Swedish language proficiency as an advantage and willingness to travel as required

About the Team

The Medium Gas Turbine (MGT) Controls organization, part of Controls, Digitalization & Nuclear Controls (CD&NUC), is responsible for developing, selling, and delivering innovative and reliable control solutions for the global MGT fleet. Our solutions enable efficient, sustainable, and reliable power generation worldwide.
As a key contributor to a growing business, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and a commitment to operational excellence. Our team of approximately 50 professionals, organized across six specialized sub-teams, drives the full spectrum of MGT controls activities, including sales enablement and bid managment, research and development, project execution, and service.

Covering all phases of the control system lifecycle, we play a critical role in shaping the future of MGT controls technology while supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their assets.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 304364 not later than 2026-10-14.
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Construction manager DRP
description:
Lead and coordinate construction activities across the scope, ensuring safe, efficient

and timely execution of the works.

Mechanical, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, Instrumentation and associated disciplines.

to ensure alignment with project priorities and execution requirements.

    Ensure construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings,

specifications, method statements, project procedures, and applicable standards.

permits, resources, and contractor preparations are aligned ahead of execution.

disciplines, contractors, vendors, and adjacent project areas.

sequencing, and delivery commitments.

support a strong safety culture across the site.

NCR resolution, and construction quality standards are maintained.

Identify construction risks, bottlenecks, and emerging issues early and drive

appropriate mitigation and corrective actions.

contractors, and relevant project stakeholders.

progress, key risks, contractor performance, priorities, and required interventions.

    Maintain close coordination with the client’s Construction Management team and

ensure effective communication between the EPCM organisation and the client.

commissioning readiness, and handover activities.

throughout the project area.

title: Total Rewards Manager
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? A rewards expert with a sharp analytical mind, proven project management skills, and a passion for using technology and AI to drive strategic impact in a fast-paced environment.

Role? Total Rewards Manager joining Vend’s Rewards team to drive our multi-year rewards strategy, lead high-impact projects and roadmaps and mentor our growing team.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Why us? This is your chance to shape the evolution of rewards in a listed company environment, lead high-impact projects end-to-end, drive the strategic implementation and communication of our multi-year rewards roadmap, and translate complex structures into clear narratives – aligning key stakeholders and acting as a vital mentor to our growing team in a supportive and forward-thinking environment.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    You have 4+ years of experience in Rewards, with a solid grasp of the Nordic compensation landscape, benefits, and compliance frameworks. Experience with navigating collective agreements and labour union relationships is an advantage.
    You have experience driving end-to-end reward processes and steering compensation frameworks to successfully embed a pay-for-performance culture.
    You possess strong project management skills – a background in management consulting or fast-paced corporate environments is an advantage.
    You are commercially sharp and analytical, able to transform complex data into clear narratives and strategic recommendations.
    You have a genuine enthusiasm for technology, with an eagerness to experiment with AI and are comfortable leveraging HRIS modules to audit data, build automated workflows and optimise reward processes.
    You have strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate a cross-border organisation and guide the organisation through structural changes.
    You bring an approachable, empathetic presence to our data-driven discipline, allowing you to engage different audiences effectively and establish credibility.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work & projects cooking As a Total Rewards Manager, your mission is to be a key player in delivering Vend's reward strategy. Your work will span the full spectrum of rewards – driving the strategic implementation and continuous evolution of our multi-year roadmap, while acting as a vital partner in shaping future rewards.

You will lead key projects end-to-end, drive reward core cycles (compensation reviews, bonus cycles), and ensure governance is coordinated across HR, Finance, and our cross-border business verticals. The role ranges from developing competitive compensation frameworks to support in preparation of the Board’s Compensation Committee meetings.

A core part of your role will be "working smarter" — you will critically review existing processes to identify opportunities for automation and digitization using AI and data analytics.

The challenge to turn into an opportunity!

You will operate in a fast-paced environment where multiple high-impact priorities run concurrently. This challenge is your opportunity to take ownership from day one, influence strategic compensation decisions at the highest level, and directly impact Vend's long-term performance culture and growth.

A few words from Quttab Aslam, Director of Total Rewards

Hi, I'm Quttab — Director of Total Rewards! Our team is collaborative, curious, and genuinely passionate about making rewards work better. We value ownership, continuous improvement, and the use of technology to work smarter. We operate at pace across a wide range of topics – from executive compensation and Board reporting to process design and analytics – and we're at our best when everyone brings their perspective to the table. Ultimately, I am looking for a true strategic sparring partner who can help design our future initiatives while actively mentoring and growing our team. If you're someone who takes initiative, thrives with autonomy, and wants to do meaningful work in a listed company environment, we'd love to hear from you.

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

The latest date to apply is the 21st of October. Please apply and tell us why this challenge speaks to you!

QUESTIONS?

José Carlos Reis, Talent Acquisition, is happy to provide information together with Quttab Aslam, Director of Total Rewards, about the daily work and answer any questions you may have!

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: Postdoctor in bacterial pathogenesis
description:
We are currently seeking a candidate for a postdoctoral position in bacterial intrauterine infections in pregnancy. The project will explore the role of specific bacterial factors in breaching the protective cervical mucus plug (CMP) that forms during pregnancy.

The candidate will join a newly established Wallenberg Centre for Molecular and Translational Medicine (WCMTM) at the University of Gothenburg (https://wcmtm.gu.se/). As part of this venture, Dr. George Birchenough has established his research group (https://www.birchenoughlab.org/) at the Department of Medical Biochemistry & Cell Biology at the University of Gothenburg. The group works towards a better understanding of how mucosal defence systems control our interactions with the environment, how those systems fail in disease and how they might be prophylactically or therapeutically targeted.

The group is part of a large network of researchers at Gothenburg University, most importantly the Mucin Biology Groups cluster (http://www.medkem.gu.se/mucinbiology/) that currently includes over 30 researchers working at the forefront of mucosal biology. The candidate will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts in multiple experimental methods that work within the cluster, as well as more widely with other local and national groups within the WCMTM network.



Subject area description

Our mucosal surfaces are the interface between the environment and our tissues. Their physiological functions are critical, but necessitate constant exposure of living cells to a vast collection of microbial lifeforms that includes many opportunistic and obligate pathogens. As a result, our mucosa have evolved multiple defensive systems that allow them to endure in this environment, and failure of these systems is often linked to development of acute and chronic disease. Consequently, understanding the development and regulation of these systems is key to understanding the pathoaetiology of mucosal disease and how they can be prevented or treated.

Approximately 15 million children are born preterm every year, resulting directly in up to 1 million annual deaths and long-term health consequences for survivors. Over half of preterm births are associated with ascension of vaginal microbes into the normally sterile intrauterine environment, and it is thought that inflammatory responses to these microbes are an important driver of early delivery. The CMP forms in the cervical canal early in pregnancy, and is thought to act as a barrier to microbial ascension. Some specific bacterial species are able to transverse this barrier and colonise the intrauterine environment, and we hypothesise that this drives the maternal inflammatory responses that can initiate preterm birth. It is currently not known which specific factors allow these bacteria to breach the CMP, but these unknown factors may represent promising anti-infective targets reducing intrauterine infection and preterm birth.

The project will therefore employ high throughput mutagenic screening with a bacterial intrauterine infection model and different mouse strains to identify specific bacterial factors that allow breach of the CMP.



Duties

The successful candidate will be expected to work extensively with bacteria, genetic manipulation and pre-clinical mouse models. The candidate will be encouraged and expected to conduct their experimental research in an independent manner and to make significant contributions to project planning. The candidate will also actively contribute to the local research environment at the Mucin Biology Groups and engage in interactions with collaborators and other groups belonging to the WCMTM network. If necessary, the candidate may also be asked to assist in the supervision of Masters or PhD students.



Eligibility

To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.

In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.  



Assessment criteria

Applications will be judged primarily on evidence of relevant scientific skills. The applicant must provide evidence of a PhD in a relevant area of research and have demonstrable skills in both written and spoken English. Previous experience working with animal bacterial infection models is essential. Any previous experience in microbial genetics, microscopy, mass spectrometry, organoid culture, flow cytometry, bioinformatics or in vivo disease modelling will be considered as merits in support of an application. Eligible applicants will be asked to partake in an interview and present their previous research. Great emphasis will be placed on the candidate’s personal suitability for the position and clear interest in the subject area.

  

Employment

The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.



Contact information

Please contact George Birchenough, senior lecturer, email: george.birchenough@gu.se



Unions

https://www.gu.se/en/work-at-the-university-of-gothenburg/how-to-apply-for-a-position#collective-agreement-and-union-representatives

The application should contain:

title: Research Software Engineer in fusion modelling and scientific computing
description:
Join an international research environment developing the software infrastructure needed for next-generation fusion modelling. You will work at the interface between scientific computing, high-performance computing and fusion research, contributing to software used within major European and international fusion programmes. The position offers the opportunity to shape sustainable scientific software and integrated modelling tools with applications ranging from present-day fusion experiments to ITER and future fusion reactors.

Information about the research group

The Plasma Physics and Fusion Energy (PPFE) group at Chalmers conducts research on the modelling, simulation and analysis of magnetically confined fusion plasmas, with a particular focus on tokamak physics. A major part of the research is aimed at developing predictive capabilities for transport in fusion-relevant plasmas and validating models against experimental observations. The group collaborates with major international fusion facilities and contributes to research supporting ITER and the development of future fusion devices.Modern fusion research increasingly relies on integrated multi-physics simulations that combine plasma transport, equilibrium, heating and current drive, turbulence, MHD stability, plasma-wall interactions, and synthetic diagnostics.

At Chalmers, we develop and maintain scientific software, workflows, and data infrastructure that enable modular, scalable, and reproducible fusion simulations. Current activities include development of the European Transport Simulator (ETS), the Transport Code Interfaces (TCI), integrated modelling frameworks based on the ITER Integrated Modelling & Analysis Suite (IMAS), workflow coupling using MUSCLE3, and execution on high-performance computing systems. The activities are closely integrated with the European fusion research programme EUROfusion and with international developments related to ITER.

Job description

As a Research Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development, integration, maintenance, and long-term sustainability of software infrastructure for integrated fusion modelling.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Develop, maintain and improve scientific software associated with integrated workflows such as ETS and TCI.
    Develop coupled multi-physics workflows using IMAS and MUSCLE3.
    Integrate numerical simulation codes written in Python, C/C++ and Fortran.
    Design reusable software components, interfaces, APIs and workflow infrastructure.
    Develop and optimise workflows for high-performance computing environments.
    Support migration and development of software for current and future versions of the IMAS Data Dictionary and Access Layer.
    Apply modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, continuous integration, documentation, version control and code review.
    Collaborate with researchers and software developers within national and European fusion programmes.
    Contribute to the development of sustainable and FAIR research software, supporting reproducible computational research.
    Support users through documentation, training and technical guidance.

Contract terms

Permanent employment

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

    A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Scientific Computing, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computational Physics or a related discipline.
    Strong programming skills in Python and experience with C/C++ and/or Fortran.
    Experience in developing scientific or research software.
    Experience with collaborative software development and tools such as Git, automated testing, continuous integration and documentation systems.
    Experience working in Linux environments.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Good written and spoken English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

    High-performance computing, including MPI, OpenMP, GPU programming or distributed computing.
    Scientific workflow systems and multi-physics coupling.
    IMAS, including IDSs, the Data Dictionary and Access Layer.
    MUSCLE3 or similar workflow-coupling frameworks.
    Integrated modelling for magnetic-confinement fusion.
    Container technologies such as Docker or Apptainer.
    HDF5 and other scientific data formats.
    FAIR research software and data, provenance and research data management.
    EUROfusion or ITER software environments.
    Numerical modelling of plasma transport, equilibrium, turbulence, MHD, heating and current drive, or plasma-material interactions.
    Development of or contributions to open-source scientific software.
    Experience with the European Transport Simulator (ETS) or Transport Code Interfaces (TCI).

title: Applied Machine Learning Lead

title: Global ESO Quality Specialist
description:
Global ESO Quality Specialist (Fixed Term 1-Year)

Primary Location: Uppsala, Sweden

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. We are now looking for a dynamic and experienced QA Specialist to join our External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a global environment, supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra while collaborating closely with external suppliers across the globe. As part of ESO, you will play a critical role in ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of our quality systems and processes.



Position Overview

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist with 2–5 years of experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries. The ideal candidate will have expertise across various QA functions, including complaint management, release activities, sterile production, documentation management, and regulatory compliance.

The position is within the External Supplier Organization (ESO) for Sterile Products, and you will work closely with external manufacturing partners and suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities

    Quality Systems

Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of robust quality systems, including complaint management, deviation management, change control, CAPA, and risk management processes. The main responsibility within the Quality Management System (QMS) area will be complaint management.

    Release Activities

Execute product release activities in compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards. Ensure the timely and accurate release of pharmaceutical products for distribution.

    Sterile Production

Provide QA oversight for sterile manufacturing operations, including aseptic processing, sterilization processes, and environmental monitoring. Ensure adherence to cGMP guidelines, regulatory standards, and applicable ISO requirements.



    Documentation Management

Manage and review quality documentation, including batch records, standard operating procedures (SOPs), risk assessments, validation protocols, and reports. Ensure documentation complies with regulatory requirements, ISO 13485, MDR, and internal quality standards.



    Regulatory Compliance

Stay up to date with regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to quality assurance. Ensure ongoing compliance with FDA regulations, applicable ISO standards, MDR requirements, and company policies.

    Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities for process improvement and quality enhancement. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and projects aimed at optimizing quality systems and operational efficiency.



Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field.

· 2–5 years of experience in a Quality Assurance role within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.

· Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

· Strong operational knowledge of medical device or pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including the production of sterile biological drugs, terminally sterilized products, and/or aseptically filled products.

· Proficiency in documentation management.

· Familiarity with regulatory requirements, including cGMP, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, MDR, and international guidelines.

· Excellent communication skills.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications

· Pharmacist degree or a Master’s degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Engineering, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific or engineering discipline.

· Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



What We Offer in Return

You will be working for an organization that embraces diversity and inclusion and believes that better outcomes are achieved by reflecting the perspectives of our diverse customer base.

Within the ESO organization, nearly 60 employees work together in a highly collaborative global environment supporting world-leading brands such as Nemluvio and Sculptra.

We offer the opportunity to work in an exciting international setting where both professional and personal development are encouraged. Our teams are based in modern offices across Europe, including Uppsala (Sweden), Alby (France), and Barcelona (Spain).

As you will be working closely with suppliers located across the globe, travel is an integral part of the position.

Who You Are

You are a resilient and quality-focused professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. You thrive in an international and collaborative environment, enjoy building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and have a passion for ensuring compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement.

Your expertise and engagement will contribute significantly to Galderma's continued growth and success.

Our People Make a Difference

At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you—and people who are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive culture create the perfect environment for people to thrive, develop, and excel in what they do.

Join us on this exciting journey and help shape the future of quality within Galderma's global External Supplier Organization.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. Do you want to contribute to improving the care of cancer patients by helping ensure the quality and compliance of innovative software medical devices?

Join RaySearch and become part of our Quality & Regulatory Affairs team. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across the organization to support and continuously improve our Quality Management System, enabling the development and delivery of safe and effective products to patients around the world.

About the role

As a Quality Specialist, you will be part of a dedicated Quality & Regulatory Affairs team supporting a growing and innovative medical device organization.

You will be involved in a variety of quality activities across the product lifecycle and have the opportunity to work closely with colleagues throughout the organization.

The role focuses on maintaining and improving our Quality Management System while supporting the organization in meeting regulatory and quality requirements in a practical and efficient way.

Your main responsibilities
